jobs.title: Product Owner, SME Banking Digital
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. The ideal candidate excels in planning, designing, scaling, and commercializing products, with a proven ability to test, validate, and optimize throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, addressing key strategic issues and functional architecture in close collaboration with business, operations, and technology teams, with a focus on shaping and executing the client channel onboarding strategy to achieve business objectives.
* Ensure alignment of channel onboarding product goals with overall business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the implementation of digital solutions across the channel onboarding domain and operations, fostering ongoing partnerships with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Facilitate business change management and process design by developing and reviewing detailed software/functional requirements and process flow diagrams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, communicating project progress to Senior Sponsors, Business Sponsors, Steering Committees, and the Program Management Office as appropriate.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for S2B channel onboarding to senior stakeholders and team members.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices within the channel onboarding domain.
* Leverage innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction

**Business**

* As the product owner, responsible for crafting the product’s vision, roadmap, and maximizing the delivery of business value in SME CADM.
* Collaborate closely with channel operations team, business units, product owners and IT resources throughout all stages of project life cycle - including investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, and implementations - to ensure business requirements are successfully implemented.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of various initiatives
* Institutionalize innovative ideas to accelerate the Bank’s digital footprint.

**Processes**

* Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines.
* Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures.
* Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding.
* Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification.
* Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies.
* Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access.
* Collaborate with regional and country digital teams to gather product customizations, facilitate country adoption, and support documentation, guidelines, and training for identity and access management tools.
* Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients.
* Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements.
* Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls.
* Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding.
* Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders.
* Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations.
* Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics.
* Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations.
* Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies.
* Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation.
* Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced.

**People & Talent**
The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties
  
  

* Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities
* Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure adherence to risk management framework.
* Act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level.
* Ensure that bank is not exposed to risks due to client channel onboarding data management by enforcing role-based access control, embed market specific data localization as part of the product design.

**Governance**

* Aligning with new Ways of Working Management Standards (nWOWS)
* Oversee & track implementation timelines, resolve impediments / blockers, ensure change communication & transition
* Good understanding of change management and project management
* Identify, analyse, prepare risk mitigation tactics and manage anticipated resistances
* Good understanding of ADO dashboard, key metrices and functions

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Operations team
* IAM team
* Business Stakeholders across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Channel product owners across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Technology team
* DCS management team
* Agile Coach

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong business and product expertise on user entitlements and client onboarding
* Product Owner experience
* Understanding of product development lifecycle
* Strong project management and planning skills, including organizational & time management skills
* Clarity of communication style and ability to face off against senior stakeholders
* Digital Transformation

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in banking, with a strong focus on managing digital channels; experience in Fintech environments is highly desirable.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience in identity and access management or channel onboar

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India
jobs.description:
About the TeamMore than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.About the RoleThis PM and Market Leader of India will oversee the newly announced pillar for WhatsApp, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp pillar, from the very first day. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.As a Product Leader at WhatsApp, you will use your experience building products from early concept through launch in fast-moving environments and your full range of product development skills to produce intuitive, user-friendly features. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.
  
  
Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India Responsibilities:
  
  

* Drive product strategy and development for one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta
* Establish a shared vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure that all teams are clear on the overall strategy, the problem to be solved, timeline, and required contributions
* Ability to move fast to drive alignment and execution – Turn high volumes of different actions into repeatable processes and playbooks, and get alignment within and across teams through both influence and framing clear escalations when team priorities conflict
* Manage multiple products and priorities, scale teams, and ensure org is effective, healthy and set up for success by establishing clear and measurable goals – Collaborate, navigate and influence product teams across WhatsApp
* Consumer, Business, Privacy, Growth and Messaging Services, and the broader Meta organization (including Instagram and Facebook)
* Drive executional excellence and analytical rigor across teams – Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions to reduce operational overhead, streamline decision-making and accelerate overall execution
* Manage business reviews (i.e., weekly/monthly business reviews, functional reviews, and other key meetings), staff meetings, and all hands meetings
* Lead reviews of dashboards and reports for stakeholders and team members to drive transparency and track improvements
* Proactively identify issues and needs, escalate as needed, and devise processes to resolve them
* Coordinate working groups for areas of ownership that we need to establish, but which cut across organizational lines
* At times, you may be specifically tasked to own a workstream, or to dive deep into different parts of the organization
* Lead org-wide projects to create business value, aligning multiple stakeholders across Meta, including various product teams, go-to-market, Finance, Operations, Research, and Family of Apps

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years leading PM teams (managing managers)
* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of bets at different maturity stages — from 0-to-1 incubation to billion-dollar scaled products — simultaneously
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy
* Experience applying analytical rigor and data-driven decision-making, including defining and optimizing product metrics and data-driven decision-making, with experience in defining and optimizing metrics

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* B.A. or B.S. in Computer Science or a related field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business)
* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts
* Proficiency in using AI tools as part of day-to-day product development and general productivity workflow
* Track record of successfully executing the strategy in the APAC region
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Design Manager - UX, Product Design
jobs.description:
**About PhonePe Limited:**
Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
  
  
PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
  
  
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
Custom description
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a strategic, highly structured Lead Product Designer / Design Manager to head the design for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms pod. You'll own the end-to-end design strategy for this scope, bring operational clarity to complex, multi-quarter projects, and lead and grow a team of 4–5 designers.
  
  
This is a high-leverage role. The Payment Gateway is how online businesses accept payments through PhonePe — the experience you design is felt by merchants and, downstream, by every customer who pays them. The details are hard, the constraints are real, and the work directly moves the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (Competencies & Role Expectations)**

* Co-own Product Roadmaps: Work closely with leadership to understand the overarching business vision and translate it into actionable, design-first GTM strategies for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms.
* Mentorship & Team Structuring: Manage, mentor, and scale a pod of 4-5 designers. Pivot effectively from individual contribution to strategic delegation—optimizing team structures, guiding career growth, and overseeing the quality of hires.
* Influence & Partner: Build deep trust with business unit leadership. Operate as a "first team" with leaders by helping them achieve their functional goals through design. Proactively resolve conflicts and align stakeholders toward common objectives.
* Build to Learn: Direct intuitive product architecture with a strong “build to learn” mindset. Emphasize continuous prototyping, synthesize insights from usability testing, and weave them into the core product strategy.
* Drive Measurable Outcomes: Define North Star metrics for your features and utilize data to form actionable insights. Ensure that design outputs directly influence business revenue and deliver measurable results.
* Holistic Architecture: Direct the team to take a holistic view of the product ecosystem, employing journey maps and service blueprints to align stakeholders and improve end-to-end service delivery.
* Orchestrate Complex Delivery: Own the planning, triaging, and delivery of multiple large, complex projects spanning across quarters. Balance competing priorities and tactically unblock teams to deliver work faster.
* Elevate Visual Systems: Deliver best-in-class, cohesive visual experiences by unifying design systems, motion, and UX copy. Foster tight feedback loops between graphics, creative, and product design teams.
* Technical Synergy: Translate complex technical/backend capabilities into highly scalable, delightful, and user-friendly interfaces, ensuring designs exploit technical constraints to enable speed and security.
* High-Quality Handoffs: Leverage your deep understanding of frontend systems and code as a medium. Deploy robust processes for smooth, repeatable engineering handoffs through high-touch communication and clear documentation.

**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**

* 7–10 years of product design experience, with real ownership of complex enterprise, B2B, or fintech platforms.
* 1–2 years managing and scaling direct reports — you've grown designers, not just reviewed their work.
* Proven craft: A portfolio that shows depth: interaction design, visual rigor, and clear reasoning behind each decision.
* Technical acumen: Deep comfort navigating technical constraints to design scalable, developer-friendly interfaces. You speak engineering's language.
* Systems thinking: You design for the whole product and are fluent with design systems — when to extend one and when to break from it.
* Strong communication: You write clear UX copy, make a tight case for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback. You manage stakeholders without losing the user's point of view.

**Design Microsite Link : https://design.phonepe.com/**

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer- AI
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer – AI**
who is passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered product experiences that simplify complex problems and create meaningful customer impact.

You will work at the intersection of Product Design, AI and emerging technologies, designing intuitive experiences that make AI capabilities accessible, useful and trustworthy for customers.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, senior leadership and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance customer experiences, rethink existing workflows and build innovative solutions.

We are looking for a designer who combines strong UI/UX fundamentals with curiosity about AI, understands how users interact with intelligent systems and can translate complex AI capabilities into simple, human-centric experiences.

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end experiences for AI-powered products and features, from problem discovery and user journeys to high-fidelity UI and interaction design.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.
  
  
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for high-impact digital, AI, and automation products across a defined product area or process domain within Client Services, including discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; influence stakeholders and resolve trade-offs to maintain delivery momentum.
* Develop fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product strategy and execution across multiple process areas.
* Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; monitor adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
* Apply rigorous critical thinking and systems thinking to ambiguous, complex, and multi-dependency Client Services challenges: frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, make sound product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
* Lead the development of AI-enabled and automated products in partnership with engineering including use-case selection, determining appropriate AI, automation, and human-intervention patterns, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Shape and deliver digital platform capabilities and workflow solutions that translate complex client and operational processes into intuitive, scalable product experiences, spanning requirements intake, solution design, decisioning, validation, approvals, integrations, execution, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate product strategy, investment rationale, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to senior stakeholders and leadership, escalating to executive sponsors as needed.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* 5 or more years of relevant product management experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including end-to-end ownership of complex digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and optimization.
* Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical judgment, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into product strategy, decisions, and clear requirements.
* Required: Demonstrated experience using AI technologies to build products, including identifying viable use cases, creating or directing prototypes, defining data and model requirements, establishing evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering to productionize solutions, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. Experience with generative AI and/or agentic AI is required.
* Required: Experience building enterprise digital, workflow, automation, or AI-enabled products, including defining product requirements, complex business rules and workflows, data and integration needs, controls, validation, and capabilities that simplify and automate complex client and operational processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Proven experience owning complex enterprise software, workflow, platform, automation, or AI products with multiple integrations, stakeholder groups, and operational dependencies.
* Strong technical acumen across enterprise systems, APIs, data architecture, integrations, cloud services, AI/ML concepts, model evaluation, and production monitoring, with the ability to understand system dependencies and make informed product, feasibility, and trade-off decisions.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way
* Strategic mindset with systems thinking, strong product judgment, and the ability to balance client value, operational impact, technical feasibility, risk, and investment trade-offs.
* Knowledge of payment systems (e.g. card networks, ACH) and banking
* Strong product execution and program leadership skills, with a record of delivering complex, multi-team, multi-region, and multi-dependency initiatives and managing risks, milestones, and value realization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and drive results in complex, multi-dependency environments, ensuring that timelines are adhered to and any risks to the project are called out early.
* Strong customer-centric mindset
* Experience redesigning and digitizing end-to-end service or operational processes using journey mappi

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Seller Payments
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.
  
  
In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.
  
  
This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
* Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
* Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:

+ Receive or earn funds
+ Add or reload money
+ Hold and manage their balance
+ Spend funds back on the eBay platform

* Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
* Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
* Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
* Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
* Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
* Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
* Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
* A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
* Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
* Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
* Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
* Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
* High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
* A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Goodscore, our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own high-impact product areas from strategy → 0→1 → scale. You’ll work closely with the Founder, Product, Engineering, Design and business leadership to identify the biggest customer problems, define the product vision, make high-conviction bets and drive them through execution.

This is a role for someone who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Product Strategy - Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for your product area. Identify high-impact opportunities through customer insights, data, market trends and first-principles thinking. Translate ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* Build 0→1 and scale products - Take products from problem discovery → product definition → launch → iteration → scale. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality products quickly.
* Build AI-native experiences - Identify where AI and agents can fundamentally improve the credit experience, rather than simply adding AI features. Experiment with new AI capabilities, workflows and agentic experiences and turn emerging technology into simple, useful experiences for millions of consumers.
* Own outcomes, not outputs - Define north-star and product metrics. Monitor performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve the product. Balance user value, business impact and execution velocity.
* Lead cross-functional execution - Work across Engineering, Design, Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Operations. Create alignment around priorities and drive execution through ambiguity. Influence without authority and bring teams together around a clear product direction.

jobs.title: Product Strategy
jobs.description:
***AI that manages your credit***

Our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

The Product Strategy role is a rare opportunity to help define what agentic AI looks like in consumer finance at India scale from deciding what we should build next, to turning entirely new ideas into products used by millions. We’re scaling from 1 to 100x. And we’re looking for people who want to build that future with us. Working closely with the Founder and Product leadership to identify opportunities, understand users, shape product bets and drive them from idea to launch to creating impact. You’ll help answer some of GoodScore’s biggest questions:

* What should we build next?
* Which consumer financial problems are worth solving?
* Where can AI create a 10x better experience?
* How do we turn an idea into a product used by millions?

**The Challenge:**

* Find the next big opportunities: Identify customer problems, market opportunities and new product bets; size them and build the business case.
* Shape what we build: Use user insights, data and competitive intelligence to influence product strategy, roadmap and prioritisation.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Product Portfolio & Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions.

  

**Key Responsiblities:**

  

**a) Portfolio strategy translation:** Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners.

  

**b) Executive stakeholder management:** Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable.

  

**c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

  

**j) Release and operational governance:** Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership.

  

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.
* Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners.
* Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations.
* Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness.
* Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change.
* Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure.
* Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
**Product Owner**
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Jaya Dadlani
  
  
Division: Product Engineering O2C
  
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.
  
  
Your HR Contact for this position is: Vipin Yadav
  
  
This role is based in: Pune

Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. :

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS

**Department:** Learning & Development

**Location:** Pune

**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications

(BCA/MCA)

  

**1. Job Purpose**

The Jr. Software Support Engineer will support the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and operational

functioning of the organisations LMS. The role includes managing user accounts and course assignments,

maintaining accurate reports, preparing and uploading digital learning content, conducting learning platform testing,

supporting system enhancements and migration activities, and resolving platform-related queries from trainers and

other stakeholders.

  

The role requires attention to detail, technical troubleshooting skills, data accuracy, and effective coordination with

internal teams to ensure reliable platform operations and continuous improvement.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Learning Platform Administration and Operational Support**

* Create and maintain user accounts, ensuring accurate user profiles, roles, locations, and project mappings.
* Manage course enrolments, programme assignments, user deactivations, and other learning platform

administrative activities.

* Monitor platform activities and screenshots as per the defined schedule.
* Track and resolve platform access and assignment-related issues within established timelines.
* Maintain records of platform activities and conduct periodic operational compliance checks.
* Ensure accurate batch and programme mapping across the platform.

**B. Reporting and Data Management**

* Extract, validate, consolidate, and maintain platform data for operational and management reporting.
* Prepare and submit weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports within defined timelines.
* Maintain trackers for user accounts, course assignments, enrolments, completions, and other platform activities.
* Verify report accuracy against source data and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain appropriate report version control and documentation.
* Provide timely and accurate data to support internal reviews and management decisions.

**C. Digital Content Development and Assessment Management**

* Convert and upload learning content in SCORM-compatible formats, where required.
* Create quizzes, assessments, and question banks aligned with course learning objectives.
* Map assessments to relevant courses and configure scoring, pass/fail criteria, and completion triggers.
* Test uploaded content for compatibility, functionality, and playback before publishing.
* Incorporate feedback and content revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain content quality standards and ensure accurate course configuration.

**D. Quality Assurance and Learning Platform Testing**

* Prepare and execute test cases for learning platform releases, updates, and enhancements.
* Identify, document, and report software defects, errors, and functional issues.
* Conduct retesting after bug fixes and validate enhancements before deployment.
* Perform regression testing to confirm that existing platform functionalities continue to work as expected.
* Validate data migration, including user records, course completions, and assessment scores, where applicable.
* Maintain test documentation, defect trackers, and quality assurance reports.
* Coordinate with developers and relevant stakeholders to support issue resolution and platform stability.

**E. Stakeholder Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical and operational support to trainers and internal stakeholders for learning platform-related

queries.

* Troubleshoot user access, course assignment, assessment, and platform usage issues.
* Maintain a query tracker documenting issue details, status, resolution, and closure.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate team and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
* Guide trainers on platform processes and the correct use of learning tools.
* Participate in mandatory internal training and undertake regular technical upskilling.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform processes, documentation, reporting, and user experience.

**F. Skills and Competencies Required**

* Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.
* Basic understanding of SCORM content, e-learning modules, and online assessments.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to conduct functional testing, document defects, and validate fixes.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and quality assurance practices.

jobs.title: Principal UX Designer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Principal UX Designer

**About Backbase**

Backbase is a leading provider of digital banking solutions. Our mission is to help banks create seamless and engaging customer experiences. We are a global company with a strong presence across the globe in Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East and the Americas. We value innovation, collaboration, and customer focus. Our team is passionate about making a difference in the financial industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Services Middle East team in our Hyderabad office. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the user experience for our innovative digital banking products. You will be involved in the entire design process, from ideation to prototyping and testing. You will work closely with cross-functional client-facing teams, including Backbase team members: project managers, business analysts, solution architects and engineers. Externally, you will work closely with senior and leadership-level client stakeholders to deliver user-centered design solutions that meet their business goals. This is a hybrid position, requiring a mix of in-office and remote work, while being flexible for client travel.

As a client-facing UX Designer, you will be a key point of contact for our clients, leading workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting design solutions. This requires excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build rapport and work effectively with clients from diverse backgrounds.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes to communicate design concepts.
* Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
* Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions and iterate on designs.
* Lead client workshops to gather requirements and present design solutions.
* Confidently present and explain design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest UX design trends and best practices.
* Support development and QA teams regarding designs.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience as a UX Designer, with experience in a client-facing role.
* A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Solid understanding of UX research methodologies and usability testing principles.
* Experience working with design systems.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Experience leading and facilitating workshops.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to effectively convey design specifications and rationale to the technical members of the team.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working in the financial, consultancy or technology industry.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.

**Please note:**

* We are looking for someone who is passionate about user-centered design and has a strong understanding of UX principles.
* Your portfolio should showcase your design process and demonstrate your ability to solve real-world problems.
* We are particularly interested in seeing examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in interaction design.
* We are looking for someone who is a team player and has excellent communication skills.
