jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist (WT- Contact Center (Ops))
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.

**Role Summary**
The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. **Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

Hello and Welcome!
  
  
HugoHub is the intelligent foundation for the future of finance, providing a modular banking platform that empowers financial institutions to move at speed.
  
  
Designed to simplify the path to digitization for small and medium-sized banks, the platform consists of both backend core platform and frontend experience layer that offer a full suite of modular banking services through a single integration. for our HugoHub Design Team, with strong expertise in user experience design, research-driven problem-solving, and system-based design thinking.

* Stays curious, updated, and keeps learning to grow as a designer.
* Questions norms to continuously improve and elevate user experiences.
* Empathises deeply, reimagines creatively, and designs with clarity and intent.
* Applies a systems-based approach to build scalable, cohesive design patterns.
* Breaks down and solves problems from the ground up with structured thinking.
* Collaborates across teams and proactively drives meaningful design improvements.
* Communicates design rationale confidently, backed with research and user insights.
* Manages time effectively, balancing exploration, iteration, and sound decision-making.

**Must Have Skills**

* Strong foundation in UX methodologies with proven experience in user research, testing, and translating insights into user-centered design.
* Ability to explore multiple design approaches and adapt based on feedback and testing.
* Deep understanding of Information Architecture and designing intuitive navigation systems.
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with established UX workflows.
* Leadership qualities to mentor junior designers and contribute to design standards and practices across the team.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience designing for B2C and B2B products, especially mobile-first experiences.
* Exposure to fintech domain projects and data-rich experiences.
* Ability to design clear, engaging layouts that simplify complex data.
* Advanced prototyping skills to create interactive prototypes for usability testing and iteration.

**How will you contribute to the company?**
You’ll collaborate with PMs, developers, fellow UX and UI designers to:
  
  

* Gather insights, advocate for users, and design thoughtful, data-informed fintech experiences.
* Communicate and present ideas, user flows, and prototypes to drive alignment across teams.
* Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and translate insights into impactful design improvements.
* Share and receive design feedback openly, growing together as a design team.
* Ship products and continuously refine experiences that thousands of users engage with daily.
* Own end-to-end design delivery across multiple product initiatives.
* Mentor interns and junior designers to build a strong design culture.
* Proactively improve the team’s design and development processes.

**HugoHub values being Responsible, Open, and Collaborative.**
You should be passionate about what HugoHub stands for:
  
  

* Honest, truthful and open communication at all times with the team members.
* We are responsible to our customers, community, and team to help shape a more open, collaborative approach to wealth. This is how HugoHub hopes to make a difference and help us build better communities.
* Shared responsibility is not only part of our approach to wealth but also a key part of working together. This shared responsibility allows for openness and candour between us as a team and in our customer relationship.
* Good ideas can come from anywhere, so an open and collaborative dialogue between the HugoHub community (customers, team, and stakeholders alike) helps us all get the best from each other and makes a difference. Everyone is welcome to apply.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist( L3)
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Senior Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist(L3)**

**Experience: 9-14 Years**  
**Function: Cybersecurity Incident Response Consultant**  
**Primary Skills: Stakeholder Management,Critical Incident Management(CIRT),Malware Analysis,Digital Forensics,Incident Reporting & Documentation,Threat Hunting,SIEM,EDR/XDR**

**Should be willing to work in Second Shift**

**Interview Mode:--Candidates must attend F2F interview for final discussion(Weekdays only)**

**Mode of work : Hybrid**

**Office Address : UV Cyber, Cyber Towers, Quadrant 3, 3rd floor, Madhapur, Hyderabad -- 500081**

  

**Role Overview**

  

**We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with 8-10 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage and investigate security incidents across enterprise environments.**

  

**The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents, including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), malware analysis, and digital forensic analysis. The role also requires strong customer-facing skills to lead incident discussions, provide regular updates, explain technical findings, and present investigation outcomes and recommendations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Incident Response & Investigation**

  

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through closure.
* Lead investigation of Critical, High, and complex security incidents and coordinate response activities across relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
* Investigate incidents involving ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, data exfiltration, insider threats, web attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other advanced threats.
* Analyze security alerts and correlate information across EDR, SIEM, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security technologies.
* Develop incident timelines and determine the attack vector, affected assets, compromised accounts, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and overall impact.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and map findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Coordinate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, Legal, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

  

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

  

* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis for security incidents.
* Determine the initial attack vector, contributing factors, security/control gaps, and reasons existing preventive or detective controls did not stop or detect the activity earlier.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned sessions.
* Develop clear corrective and preventive actions based on investigation findings.
* Track remediation recommendations with relevant stakeholders through closure.
* Prepare comprehensive RCA reports suitable for technical teams, management, and customers.

  

**Malware Analysis**

  

* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand malicious file behavior and capabilities.
* Analyze suspicious executables, scripts, PowerShell commands, documents, URLs, and other artifacts.
* Identify malware persistence mechanisms, command-and-control activity, network indicators, file-system changes, registry modifications, and related behaviors.
* Extract IOCs and behavioral indicators for threat hunting and detection engineering.
* Perform malware sandboxing and behavioral analysis where required.
* Provide recommendations for detection, containment, and prevention based on malware-analysis findings.

  

**Digital Forensics**

  

* Perform digital forensic investigations on endpoints and other relevant systems.
* Analyze Windows/Linux artifacts, event logs, file systems, registry artifacts, browser artifacts, authentication logs, memory artifacts, and other forensic evidence.
* Perform disk and memory analysis where required.
* Collect and preserve digital evidence following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements.
* Build forensic timelines and reconstruct attacker activities.
* Determine the scope and impact of compromise using forensic evidence.
* Document forensic findings clearly and maintain investigation evidence appropriately.

  

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Act as a key technical point of contact for customers during cybersecurity incidents.
* Lead incident calls and communicate investigation progress, impact, containment status, risks, and next steps.
* Provide timely and accurate incident updates to customers and internal leadership.
* Translate complex technical investigation findings into clear business-level communication.
* Manage customer expectations during high-severity and time-sensitive incidents.
* Present RCA and forensic investigation findings to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Handle technical questions and confidently explain investigation methodology, evidence, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with multiple internal and customer teams to drive incidents toward timely resolution.

  

**Incident Reporting & Documentation**

  

* Prepare detailed incident investigation reports, including:
* Maintain accurate incident records, evidence, investigation notes, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of Incident Response playbooks, SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
* Executive summary
* Incident timeline
* Scope and impact
* Root cause
* Attack vector
* IOCs and TTPs
* Investigation findings
* Containment and remediation actions
* Control gaps
* Corrective and preventive recommendations
* Lessons learned

  

**Required Technical Skills**

  

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in:

  

* Cybersecurity Incident Response / DFIR
* Security Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Digital Forensics
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Endpoint and Network Investigation
* Windows and Linux Forensics
* Disk and Memory Analysis
* Log Analysis and Timeline Reconstruction
* IOC and TTP Analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
* EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar
* Network security technologies including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Proxy, DNS, VPN, and WAF
* Cloud security investigation across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments
* Identity and authentication-related investigations
* Email and phishing investigations
* Forensic and malware-analysis tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, Wireshark, Sysinternals, YARA, Ghidra, IDA, or equivalent tools
* Scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies would be an advantage.

  

**Required Experience**

  

* 8-10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, DFIR, SOC, Threat Hunting, or related security domains.
* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex and high-severity cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong experience conducting RCA and presenting investigation findings.
* Hands-on experience with malware and forensic investigations.
* Experience handling customer-facing security incidents and leading technical/customer incident calls.
* Experience coordinating investigations involving multiple technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during Critical/High-severity incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  

**Communication & Leadership Skills:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role exists to support sustainable retail portfolio growth by making prudent, timely and consistent credit decisions for mortgage and wealth management products. The role evaluates customers’ creditworthiness, risk exposure, affordability and application quality to ensure lending decisions align with the Bank’s credit policies, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and business objectives.
  
  
The role balances risk management with customer experience by ensuring credit applications are assessed accurately, efficiently and consistently. It contributes to portfolio quality, operational effectiveness and business growth through sound underwriting judgement, risk assessment and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The role also supports the evolution of credit operations by identifying opportunities to improve turnaround times, strengthen controls, support product launches and contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service delivery and decision-making effectiveness. Where applicable, the role provides operational guidance, supports team capability development and helps maintain underwriting consistency across the function.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Credit Assessment & Underwriting**  
• Assess retail mortgage and wealth management applications to deliver prudent credit decisions that balance customer needs with portfolio risk objectives.
  
• Evaluate customer financial profiles, affordability, repayment capacity and credit history to determine appropriate lending outcomes.
  
• Apply credit policies, underwriting standards and delegated authorities consistently to support high-quality credit decision-making.
  
• Escalate complex or higher-risk cases appropriately to ensure sound risk governance and decision integrity.
  
**Credit Risk & Fraud Management**  
• Identify, assess and mitigate credit and fraud risks that may affect portfolio quality or customer outcomes.
  
• Apply regulatory requirements and internal risk controls to ensure lending decisions remain compliant and defensible.
  
• Detect indicators of potential fraud, misrepresentation or suspicious activity and initiate appropriate escalation processes.
  
• Support a strong risk culture through disciplined application of credit policies and controls.
  
**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**  
• Improve underwriting efficiency by identifying process enhancements that reduce turnaround times while maintaining control effectiveness.
  
• Contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service quality, productivity and customer experience.
  
• Support the implementation of new products, policy changes and process enhancements to ensure operational readiness.
  
• Use operational insights and performance trends to recommend improvements in credit assessment and workflow management.

**Business Support & Stakeholder Collaboration**  
**• Partner with Product, Sales, CRM, Fraud Risk, Lending Operations and support teams to facilitate effective credit assessment and application processing.**  
**• Provide underwriting expertise that supports business growth initiatives, marketing campaigns and new product introductions.**  
**• Resolve credit-related queries and exceptions by collaborating with relevant stakeholders to achieve balanced customer and risk outcomes.**

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description:
**VP of Product, Tokenized Deposits**

Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each
* Decide what is standard product and what is customization, and hold that line with clients
* Define our standard implementation approach with banks, from first workshop to pilot to production
* Turn what we learn at each client into product, with one prioritized backlog across all projects
* Work with engineering and partners to deliver, and take responsibility for acceptance

**What you bring**

* Tokenized money shipped to production (tokenized deposits, stablecoins or DLT-based settlement) in a regulated setting
* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews
* Strong command of payments infrastructure and ISO 20022
* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects
* Fluent English; based in the UAE or willing to travel

**Nice to have**

* MENA or African market experience, Arabic
* Familiarity with interbank ledger initiatives (Swift, regional networks) and EVM chains
* Product experience under SOC 2 or ISO 27001/27017/27018
* Public speaking or published work on tokenization

**What we offer**

* Real ownership of the product of a company bringing tokenized deposits to banks in new markets
* A competitive package for a senior hire
* A seat in decisions about what we build and who we build it for.

**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to lead design for Krak and help us build a neobank people trust with their everyday money.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role with responsibility for design across the product. You’ll set the direction for the Krak experience, influence product strategy, and stay close to the details through execution.
  
  
We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.
  
  
Building a neobank means earning people’s trust in the moments that matter: getting started, moving money, making a payment, or understanding what’s happened when something goes wrong. You’ll help make those experiences clear and reliable, bringing the same care to everyday interactions as you do to the overall product vision.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Own the design direction for Krak, connecting onboarding, accounts, payments, and spending into one coherent experience.
* Make everyday banking clear and intuitive, from understanding balances and fees to tracking payments and resolving problems.
* Shape product strategy and roadmap decisions with product, engineering, and leadership.
* Lead hands-on design and prototyping, setting the standard for interaction design, visual craft, and accessibility.
* Work with compliance, risk, and operations to make verification, security, and account recovery straightforward for customers.
* Evolve Krak’s design system and align teams around consistent patterns.
* Use research and data to improve the product, and mentor designers through critique and collaboration.What You’ll Bring

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped consumer mobile experiences.
* Experience operating at Staff level or above, leading design across a product or several connected teams.
* Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to work through complex financial journeys and their edge cases.
* Advanced prototyping skills and experience building or evolving design systems.
* Evidence of influencing product strategy, resolving competing priorities, and guiding work through delivery.
* Clear communication, sound design judgment, and experience mentoring other designers.
* Experience designing banking, payments, or personal finance products is a strong plus.

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.
  
  
We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Learn on the Kraken Blog
  
  
Connect on LinkedIn

jobs.title: UX Product Owner (Personal Loans)
jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Credit team at Revolut creates and scales lending features that power global growth. They manage the entire product lifecycle, from backend systems to customer-facing experiences. By combining market insight, risk expertise, and technical precision, they deliver safe, forward-thinking solutions tailored to each region.
  
  
We’re looking for a Product Owner to lead our unsecured personal loan roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.
  
  
You’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for these features.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
* Driving maximum impact based on data analysis, market research, and company strategy
* Owning your team's products, from ideation through development, to launch, growth, and maintenance
* Working closely with Design and UX teams to define the customer journey and create an outstanding customer experience
* Liaising with Engineering to ensure effective delivery
* Partnering with other stakeholders, such as Marketing, Legal, and Strategy teams

**What You'll Need**

* 3+ years of experience at a high-growth tech company or in banking/finance-related business areas (acquiring, payments, investments, cryptocurrency, insurance, etc.)
* 2+ years of proven success leading loan products
* 1+ years of experience managing people
* Outstanding communication skills
* An eye for great UX/UI and an impeccable understanding of design best practices
* High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
* Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
* Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
* A readiness to provide insight and deliver measurable results under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment
* An entrepreneurial drive to never settle

**Nice to have**

* A STEM degree

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.**
If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against
* Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale
* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components
* Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on
* Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority
* Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

**Nice to haves**

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house
* Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms
* Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps
* Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

jobs.description:
**Senior Digital Business Specialist - Retail Onboarding Tribe**

Embark on a journey where your unique contributions are celebrated, and your professional growth is embraced. At ADCB, we nurture a diverse, inclusive community where every voice is valued.

**About the business area**

The Retail Banking Group (RBG) supports retail and micro-business customers in managing their finances, through expert advice and the provision of a full suite of specialist products and services in conventional and Shari’ah compliant banking. The business is committed to driving digital innovation to deliver excellence in customer service. We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

**In this role, your key responsibilities include**
:

* **Digital Onboarding Journey Development:**
  Lead business analysis for end-to-end digital onboarding journeys for credit cards, CASA and personal loans across mobile, web and assisted channels. Work with product owners, channel, credit, operations, compliance and marketing teams to gather and refine requirements. Prepare business and functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, process maps, wireframes and prototypes. Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT): plan it, write and run test cases, and manage defects through to go-live.
* **Regulatory and Compliance Projects:**
  Turn regulatory and internal policy requirements into clear business and system requirements. These include Central Bank of the UAE guidelines, KYC/AML and customer due diligence, UAE PASS and Emirates ID verification, consumer protection and data privacy. Make sure onboarding journeys meet all control, audit and reporting obligations and that changes are delivered within regulatory deadlines.
* **Journey Optimisation and Conversion:**
  Analyse onboarding funnels, drop-offs, turnaround times and straight-through processing rates for each product. Find the points where customers struggle and recommend improvements, such as fewer steps, pre-filled data, instant decisioning, digital document upload and save-and-resume. Work with the Digital Fulfilment team to recover customers who drop out of digital journeys.
* **Acquisition Performance and Reporting:**
  Support the design and rollout of acquisition campaigns and promotions for cards, CASA and personal loans, coordinating with marketing and product teams. Track applications, approvals, account openings, card activations and loan disbursals. Report performance against tribe KPIs and keep product owners and tribe leadership informed of progress, risks and opportunities.
* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:**
  Act as the link between business and technology teams, including core banking, loan origination, card management and credit decisioning systems and third-party partners. Keep the product backlog prioritised and support Agile ceremonies. Track dependencies, and coach and review the work of junior business analysts.
* **Policies, Processes, Systems and Procedures:**
  Follow all relevant organisational and departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures and instructions. This ensures work meets the required standard, is done consistently and gives customers and stakeholders the expected level of service. Make sure onboarding changes are documented and approved through the bank's governance and change processes.
* **Self-Management:**
  Manage self in line with the bank's people management policies, procedures, processes and practices, to stay compliant and make the most of own contribution to business performance.
* **Customer Service:**
  Show Our Promise and apply the ADCB Service Standards in every internal and external customer interaction. Put the customer at the centre when designing simple, secure and compliant onboarding journeys.

T
**he ideal candidate should have the following experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in delivering projects including at least 2 years of experience in Digital Onboarding within a Bank
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant specialization
* Knowledge of Web Channels and Mobile Technologies
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Planning, Analytical and Time Management
* Written and Spoken English

**What we offer:**

* **Competitive Salary**
  : The indicative pay range for this role is AED 30000– AED 35000 per month. Additionally, all employees are eligible to participate in one of our rewarding variable pay plans.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package**
  : This includes market-leading medical insurance, group life and personal accident insurance, paid leave and leave airfare, employee preferential rates on loans and finance facilities, staff discounts and offers, and children education assistance (for certain job levels).
* **Flexible and Remote Working Options**
  : We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, subject to eligibility and job requirements.
* **Learning and Development Opportunities**
  : We value and facilitate continuous learning and personal development, through a variety of exciting learning opportunities, such as structured instructor-led courses, a comprehensive e-Learning catalog, on-the-job training and professional development programs.

At ADCB, we are dedicated to creating a respectful, caring and disciplined work environment that aligns with your career ambitions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Associate Product Specialist, Launch Program 2027 – Dubai, UAE (UAE National Preferred)
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
  
  
Our Purpose
  
  
We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program?
  
  
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact. Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard.
  
  
Product Management
  
  
You will have the chance to learn how to develop business cases for new product opportunities, develop scalable customer-centric products, and see those projects through to go-to-market. When joining one of our highly collaborative product teams, you will have the opportunity to build and manage great products. We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for developing scalable customer-centric products with agility and excellence.
  
  
What you’ll do

Identify and measure product and business metrics to increase adoption and understand customers’ ongoing needs
  
  
Conduct iterative experiments to identify and prioritise key features for inclusion with product releases and product roadmap
  
  
Assist customers to resolve operational issues that have been escalated
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, with an anticipated graduation date between March 2026 and August 2027
  
  
Available to start on 1st March or 1st September 2027
  
  
Analytical and problem-solving skills
  
  
Strong strategic and conceptual aptitude
  
  
High-energy, can-do attitude, very strong sense of ownership
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.

* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, MENA Treasury
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The role**
------------

We are looking for an analytical and organised Senior Analyst to help deliver the MENA Treasury team’s safeguarding and operational responsibilities. Working closely with the Senior Associate, you will take ownership of defined daily processes, including safeguarding calculations and reconciliations, payment and funding activity, exception investigation, and management information. You will use your judgement to resolve routine issues, identify emerging risks, and escalate material or complex matters promptly.

This is a hands-on role in a regulated payments environment, with scope to improve the quality and resilience of Treasury processes. You will apply a strong control mindset and sound technical skills across safeguarding, cash management, liquidity, and Treasury operations, while helping translate policies into consistent day-to-day execution.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the preparation and review of daily safeguarding calculations and reconciliations for assigned MENA merchant funds, ensuring they follow regulations, approved policies, account structures, and controls.
* Analyse balances and supporting data, investigate breaks and aged reconciling items, coordinate resolution with relevant teams, and escalate potential shortfalls, control failures, or unusual activity promptly to the Senior Associate.
* Instruct and monitor approved safeguarding, funding, settlement, and intercompany transfers within delegated authority; perform appropriate checks and maintain clear evidence in line with control requirements.
* Monitor bank accounts, payment flows, and funding positions; analyse variances and follow through on operational queries with internal teams and banking partners.
* Produce and maintain accurate daily Treasury records, reconciliations, trackers, and management information; investigate data-quality issues and highlight meaningful trends or exceptions.
* Prepare recurring reporting and analysis for Treasury management and governance forums, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and clearly explained.
* Maintain procedures, process maps, control evidence, and supporting documentation for assigned processes; identify control gaps and recommend practical process improvements or automation.
* Coordinate evidence and responses for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and information requests; track actions to closure and escalate matters requiring interpretation or management input.
* Analyse payment flows and assess potential safeguarding and operational impacts of product, market, or regulatory changes; document findings and recommendations for review.
* Build effective working relationships with Treasury colleagues and partner teams across Finance, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Legal to resolve issues and deliver reliable execution.
* Provide cover for other MENA Treasury activities when required, operating within documented controls and delegated authority.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in Treasury, payments, banking, finance operations, or a related financial-services role; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Experience with reconciliations, payment operations, cash movements, or financial controls in a high-volume or regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of safeguarding and customer-funds protection, including segregation, reconciliations, fund flows, and escalation of exceptions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, investigate discrepancies, explain findings, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and confidence working with operational systems and reporting tools; experience with a Treasury management system is an advantage.
* A control-minded, organised approach and the confidence to raise a concern when something does not look right.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work constructively across teams and manage competing daily priorities.
* Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**It would be useful if you also have**
---------------------------------------

* Exposure to a regulated payments provider, Electronic Money Institution, bank, or similar financial institution.
* Familiarity with UAE payments or safeguarding requirements, including the CBUAE framework.
* Exposure to cash management, liquidity monitoring, FX, or Treasury systems such as Kyriba or FXall.
* Experience documenting procedures, supporting audits, or improving and automating operational processes.

**How you will contribute**
---------------------------

You will deliver accurate and timely Treasury processes, provide dependable analysis and control evidence, and ensure exceptions are understood and acted on promptly. You will bring ownership to defined areas of activity and help strengthen the team’s operational resilience across MENA safeguarding and Treasury.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
