jobs.title: : Business Head – Loan Distribution .
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position:** Business Head – Loan Distribution  
**Level:** Senior Management  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Industry:** Banking, NBFCs & Financial Services  
**Reporting To:** Co-Founder / Promoter  
**Joining Requirement:** Immediate / Within 30 Days

**About the Opportunity**

Our client, an emerging financial services organization, is looking to appoint a dynamic, entrepreneurial and result-oriented **Business Head – Loan Distribution** to establish, lead and scale its loan distribution business.

This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced BFSI professional, preferably from the Banking or NBFC industry, with a strong track record in loan distribution, business development, institutional relationship management, DSA operations and team leadership.

The incumbent will have end-to-end responsibility for building the business from the ground up, establishing strategic partnerships with Banks, NBFCs and Housing Finance Companies (HFCs), developing a robust loan distribution network, building a high-performing team and driving sustainable business growth.

The role offers direct interaction with the Co-Founder / Promoter and an opportunity to independently shape the organization's business strategy, operating model and long-term growth trajectory.

**Preferred Industry Background**

We are particularly interested in candidates currently or recently associated with the following Banking and NBFC segments:

**1. Banking Industry**

* Private Sector Banks
* Public Sector Banks
* Small Finance Banks
* Retail and Corporate Lending
* Loan Distribution and DSA Business

**2. NBFC Industry (Non-Banking Financial Companies)**

Candidates from the following NBFC segments will be strongly preferred:

* Retail Lending Companies
* Consumer Finance Companies
* Vehicle Finance Companies
* Commercial Vehicle Finance
* Gold Loan Companies
* Housing Finance Companies (HFCs)
* Microfinance Institutions (MFIs)
* MSME Lending Companies
* Personal Loan Companies
* Loan Against Property (LAP)
* Infrastructure Finance Companies
* Asset Finance Companies

**Illustrative Organizations:** Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, Muthoot Finance, Malappuram Finance, Cholamandalam Investment and Finance, Tata Capital and other established Banking / NBFC organisations etc

Candidates with relevant experience in Loan Distribution, DSA Business, Financial Services and Institutional Lending Partnerships will also be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Strategy & Business Setup**

* Lead the end-to-end establishment and development of the Loan Distribution business.
* Develop business strategies, operating models, revenue frameworks and long-term growth roadmaps.
* Establish business processes, internal controls and performance benchmarks.
* Identify target customer segments, lending products and emerging business opportunities.

**2. Institutional Relationships & Strategic Alliances**

* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with Banks, NBFCs and HFCs.
* Develop partnerships with Corporate DSAs, channel partners, aggregators and financial intermediaries.
* Lead negotiations on commercial terms, commission structures and revenue-sharing arrangements.
* Expand the institutional network to maximise business opportunities and revenue generation.

**3. Team Building & Organisational Leadership**

* Build, recruit and lead a high-performing team of approximately 40–50 employees and business associates.
* Establish organisational structures, reporting hierarchies and functional responsibilities.
* Recruit and manage Sales Managers, Relationship Managers, Telecallers and Field Sales Teams.
* Drive performance management, productivity, accountability and business reviews.

**4. Business Development & Revenue Generation**

Drive sourcing, business conversion, disbursement and revenue generation across multiple lending products, including:

* Home Loans
* Loan Against Property (LAP)
* Loan Against Rent Receivables (LARR)
* Business Loans / MSME Loans
* Personal Loans
* Other Secured and Unsecured Lending Products
* Develop direct sourcing channels, referral networks and strategic distribution partnerships.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.
* Identify new markets, customer segments and geographical expansion opportunities.

**5. Operations, MIS & Business Governance**

* Establish efficient sourcing, documentation, login, processing and disbursement workflows.
* Monitor business pipelines, team productivity, conversion ratios and revenue realisation.
* Implement robust MIS, dashboards and periodic performance reviews.
* Ensure adherence to KYC requirements, lending partner guidelines and applicable regulatory processes.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Graduate / Postgraduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Approximately 8–15 years of relevant experience in Banking, NBFCs, Loan Distribution, DSA or Financial Services.
* **Preference will be given to candidates currently working with established Banking or NBFC organisations.**
* Demonstrated experience in establishing, scaling or managing a Loan Distribution / DSA business.
* Strong institutional relationships with Banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other financial institutions.
* Proven ability to build, manage and lead large sales and distribution teams, preferably 30–50 or more employees and business associates.
* Strong business development, negotiation, strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to independently drive business growth and take complete business ownership.

**Joining Requirement – Important**

* Candidates who can join **immediately or within a maximum of 30 days** will be strongly preferred.
* Candidates serving their notice period with a confirmed early-release possibility may also be considered.
* Preference will be given to candidates with relevant and recent experience in Banking and NBFC organisations, particularly in Loan Distribution, DSA Business and Lending Partnerships.

**Key Success Expectations**

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

* Establishing the complete organisational and operational structure of the business.
* Securing strategic lending partnerships and institutional tie-ups.
* Recruiting and developing a high-performing team of 40–50 employees and business associates.
* Creating a robust and sustainable business sourcing and distribution network.
* Achieving defined business sourcing, disbursement and revenue targets.
* Building a scalable, profitable and professionally managed Loan Distribution platform.

**The Opportunity**

This position is ideal for a seasoned BFSI professional with an entrepreneurial mindset who is passionate about building businesses, creating distribution networks and delivering measurable business outcomes.

The incumbent will have the opportunity to work closely with the Co-Founder / Promoter, exercise significant business ownership and contribute directly to the organization’s strategic growth and expansion.

**Interested candidates may share their updated resumes at head.hr@tiptopinsure.in or connect directly at 8420363349.**

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Product, Exchange - Traded Products
jobs.description:
Are you looking for the next professional opportunity that will challenge you and advance your career? Join our team now!

**Tickmill**
is expanding its
**Exchange-Traded Products**
offering, starting with
**Stocks and ETFs**
. We are looking for an experienced
**Head of Product, Exchange-Traded Products**
to drive this strategic initiative and help shape the future of investing products across our platforms.

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for
**Stocks & Exchange-Traded Products**
, working closely with Technology, Brokerage, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and Affiliate teams. This role requires a strong understanding of both trading products and retail brokerage operations.

Founded in 2014, Tickmill has grown into a global financial services group of 300+ people, with regulated entities across major jurisdictions and a client base built on trust in active trading, spanning CFDs, Futures and Options.

* Strong technical fluency and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Experience working with providers such as Interactive Brokers, Saxo, DriveWealth, Apex, Alpaca or similar platforms is considered an advantage.

**By joining us, you can expect:**

* Opportunities to learn and grow through our "Employee Training & Development Program".

**What to expect from our recruitment process:**

2. Product and stakeholder management interview.

Make your next career step and apply NOW!

jobs.title: Head of Agile Transformation
jobs.description:
**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Network International is the largest Financial Technology company in Middle East and Africa. Payments is our core business where we provide services in more than 50 countries – UAE, Jordan, South Africa, Egypt are some of our key markets. Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we are growing in direct to consumer card segment as well.
  
  
**Our EVP**
At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Agile Transformation will lead Acquiring's evolution into a more product-led, agile and insight-driven organisation. Working across Product, Technology, Data, Business Teams, Leadership and Transformation Partners, the role will assess current maturity, define the target operating model and embed practical ways of working suited to Network International.
  
  
The role will create the governance, capabilities, roles and operating practices needed for successful product delivery, while delivery outcomes remain shared across Product, Technology and the wider organisation. As maturity increases, the remit will evolve towards broader product strategy, portfolio management, investment prioritisation and value creation.
  
  
**The Transformation Journey**

* Discover: Assess maturity and define the target state and roadmap.
* Transform: Establish the Product and Agile operating model.
* Embed: Build internal capability, a Centre of Excellence and partner knowledge transfer.
* Scale: Extend and continuously improve successful practices.
* Evolve: Broaden influence over Product strategy, portfolio choices and value creation.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Lead Product & Agile Transformation**

* Own the transformation vision, business case, roadmap, milestones and success measures; assess maturity and sequence priorities.
* Align Product, Technology, Data, business leadership and partners around a common target state, removing organisational, governance and behavioural barriers.
* Keep the transformation practical, commercially relevant and aligned with customer, risk and enterprise priorities, using AI-enabled tools to accelerate adoption.

**Establish Product-led & Agile Ways Of Working**

* Design and embed a scalable operating model covering team structures, governance, decision rights, funding principles, delivery cadences and performance measures.
* Clarify accountabilities across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data, Operations, Sales and delivery roles.
* Embed customer-led discovery, prioritisation and outcome-based planning; apply Scrum, Kanban or scaled approaches according to context.
* Improve Product-Technology collaboration, portfolio visibility, dependency management, predictability and speed to value.

**Build Capability & Organizational Ownership**

* Build Product and Agile capability from executive leadership to delivery teams through structured learning, coaching and practical application.
* Establish a Product and Agile Centre of Excellence, communities of practice, playbooks, role standards and internal coaching capability.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change adoption; govern transformation partners and progressively transfer knowledge and ownership into Network International.

**Enable Insight-led Decisions & Demonstrate Value Through Data & AI:**

* Embed customer insight, product analytics, commercial measures and operational data into discovery, prioritisation and lifecycle decisions.
* Identify responsible uses of AI for research, experimentation, requirements, knowledge management and decision support, with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Maintain a balanced scorecard covering adoption, capability, flow, predictability, quality, customer outcomes and commercial value; report progress, risks and benefits transparently.

**Qualifications**
**Key Requirements:**
**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years across Agile transformation, Product operating models, Product management, technology delivery or enterprise change, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
* Proven success leading large-scale Product and Agile transformation across multiple teams or business units in a complex, regulated organization.
* Strong experience designing Product-led operating models, including governance, roles, team structures, portfolio practices, outcome-based planning and investment prioritization.
* Hands-on expertise in Product discovery, Agile delivery, organizational design, change leadership, executive influence, coaching and capability building.
* Experience managing transformation partners, establishing a Centre of Excellence and transferring capability into internal teams.
* Track record of measuring adoption, delivery performance, customer impact and business value; practical understanding of responsible AI, data privacy and security.

**Head of Platform Product**
to join our technology leadership team, reporting directly to the CTO. This role will
**manage and grow the Platform Product organization**
and
**extend product ownership across the CTO-line platform product portfolio**
, including infrastructure-facing product lines such as AI platform, compliance infrastructure, financial cloud, and developer tooling.

**regulated, AI-native financial institution**
.

* Drive team health, OKR quality, and delivery rigor across 10+ sub-teams and 200+ active requirements
* Build a high-performance product culture: elevate product thinking from requirement-taking to systems-level ownership; enforce outcome-based OKRs over go-live checklists
* Recruit, develop, and retain senior product talent; proactively manage succession and capability gaps

  (knowledge distillation, MCP integration, personalization engine)

  **AI-native product development**
  — 100% AI documentation coverage, AI-assisted requirement analysis, and measurable AI efficiency gains
* Define and drive the
  **killing feature strategy**
  for the AI agent platform: identify the user acquisition hook that converts infrastructure investment into real user growth

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  of product management experience, with at least
  **5 years in a senior product leadership role**
  managing multi-team product organizations (20+ PMs)

  **platform/infrastructure products**
  — not just consumer-facing features; experience with developer platforms, internal tooling, or B2B SaaS is highly valued
* Strong
  **systems thinking**
  : ability to define product architecture, module catalogs, and API contracts — not just user stories

  (fintech, banking, crypto, or equivalent); understanding of how regulatory requirements translate into product constraints and opportunities

  **drive OKR quality**
  — moving teams from go-live metrics to outcome-based measurement

  — required for internal communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

* Experience with
  **AI product strategy**
  — agent platforms, LLM-powered products, or AI infrastructure products

  **financial services technology**
  or
  **crypto/Web3**

  **organizational restructuring**
  or rapid scaling
* Familiarity with
  **multi-jurisdiction compliance**
  product challenges (KYC/KYB, AML, regulatory data reporting, multi-site architecture)
* Track record of
  **defining and launching platform "killing features"**
  — not just maintaining existing product lines

Leadership Profile

* **Prioritization discipline**

jobs.description:
Location: Burj Daman Tower, Al Mustaqbal Street, DIFC

Position reports to : CEO Multipass

**Role Overview**

The Branch CEO / Senior Executive Officer is the accountable executive for MultiPass's DIFC branch and the leader of its next stage of UAE growth. The role combines regulated executive leadership, delivery of a mainland licensing programme, and direct commercial ownership. The successful candidate will protect the branch's regulatory standing, build trusted relationships with regulators and local banking partners, originate revenue personally, and create a high-performing Sales and Business Development organisation.

**The Three Core Mandates**

1.
**Lead the DIFC branch.**
Act as Branch CEO and, subject to regulatory approval, Senior Executive

Officer; own governance, regulatory engagement, compliance, local banking relationships,

operational performance, and the branch's reputation.

2.
**Deliver mainland authorisation.**
Lead the end-to-end programme to identify and obtain the

appropriate UAE mainland electronic-money and/or payment-services licence or authorisation,

working with the relevant federal and mainland authorities and external advisers.

3.
**Grow the revenue base.**
Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Branch Leadership, Regulation and Banking Relationships**

* Serve as the senior accountable executive for the DIFC branch and provide coordination for
* strategy, governance, culture, risk, compliance, operations, and financial performance.
* Maintain a proactive, transparent, and credible relationship with the Dubai Financial Services
* Authority (DFSA), including timely regulatory engagement, notifications, returns, remediation, and responses to supervisory requests.
* Ensure the branch operates within its permissions, policies, risk appetite, and applicable DIFC/DFSA requirements, with particular attention to AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct, safeguarding, prudential oversight, outsourcing, and financial-crime controls.
* Chair or participate in branch governance forums; ensure decisions, delegated authorities, management information, incident escalation, and board or group reporting are clear and effective.
* Own senior relationships with local banks, safeguarding or settlement partners, payment providers, professional advisers, and other critical counterparties; negotiate resilient and commercially sound arrangements.

**2. UAE Mainland Licensing Programme**

* Define the target regulated business model and licensing strategy for mainland UAE, aligned with MultiPass's products, client segments, risk appetite, capital plan, and growth ambitions.
* Lead the feasibility study and business case for the mainland licence.
* Coordinate internal Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Treasury, and People teams, together with external legal and regulatory advisers.
* Oversee preparation of the business plan, governance and ownership materials, financial projections, capital and liquidity plans, policies, control frameworks, technology and outsourcing documentation, and evidence of operational readiness.
* Build constructive relationships with the relevant UAE authorities, including the Central Bank of the UAE where applicable, and ensure all submissions are accurate, consistent, and delivered to the agreed standard and timetable.
* Translate licensing conditions into an executable mobilisation plan and ensure the mainland entity or operation is ready to launch without weakening the DIFC branch's controls or service quality.

**3. Revenue Growth and Commercial Team Build**

* Own the UAE branch revenue plan, client-acquisition strategy, commercial pipeline, and contribution to profitability, with clear monthly and quarterly targets.
* Personally originate, negotiate, and close high-value clients and strategic partnerships, particularly among internationally active businesses requiring multi-currency accounts, cross-border payments, and FX services.
* Develop a strong network across the UAE business, banking, professional-services, investment, and fintech communities and represent MultiPass at relevant market and industry forums.
* Recruit and lead the Sales and Business Development team; define coverage, roles, incentives, targets, account ownership, onboarding standards, and performance-management routines.
* Implement a disciplined commercial operating system covering CRM hygiene, lead qualification, pipeline reviews, conversion, pricing governance, revenue attribution, forecasting, client retention, and cross-sell.
* Work closely with Compliance, Product, Operations, Treasury, and Group leadership to ensure commercial growth remains within risk appetite and that client feedback informs product and service development.

**4. People, Operations and Profitability**

* Build a high-accountability, client-focused branch culture in line with DYNINNO Corporate Values.
* Own the branch operating plan and budget; manage cost, headcount, vendor performance, revenue quality, and progress toward sustainable profitability.
* Ensure the branch has appropriate business-continuity, operational-resilience, information-security, complaints, and incident-management arrangements.
* Provide concise, decision-useful reporting to Group leadership and the Board.

**Requirements**

* Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head or equivalent within regulated payments, electronic money, B2B fintech or transaction banking.
* Strong UAE market knowledge, including practical experience engaging with regulators and understanding DIFC/DFSA requirements and the UAE mainland regulatory environment.
* Experience leading licensing or authorisation programmes, including regulatory submissions, coordination with external advisers and preparation for operational launch. UAE payments or electronic-money licensing experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven personal track record in B2B client acquisition, negotiating and closing high-value corporate clients and strategic partnerships, ideally in cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts or FX.
* An established UAE business and banking network, with the ability to develop relationships with corporate clients, local banks, payment providers and referral partners.
* Experience building and leading Sales and Business Development teams, with clear revenue targets, pipeline management, forecasting and performance accountability.
* Strong governance, risk and compliance expertise, including AML/CFT, sanctions, financial-crime controls and operational resilience.
* P&L and operational leadership experience, covering business planning, budgeting, cost management and sustainable revenue growth.
* Ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, working closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Technology and Operations, and reporting effectively to Group leadership and the Board.

**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
  
  
We're looking for a Head of Product to rethink our products and fraud systems to be AI-centric. You'll leverage AI for automation and enable intuitive, multi-modal customer interactions to build trust and streamline compliance processes.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Leading and building AI; Machine Learning; Data Science products to solve business problems
* Leading a financial crime product team, designing features that improve security across Revolut’s global platform
* Building teams to align with product objectives and developing team members to enable their career growth
* Overseeing your team's product roadmap, from strategic planning and conception, to execution and launch.

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of product management experience
* 3+ years of experience managing large teams
* Experience managing AI products, data science products, customer-facing products, and back office systems
* Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
* High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
* A bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on
* Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
* The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

jobs.description:
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**

As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.
* Corridor & Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership and banking network expansion opportunities across emerging and developed APAC markets.
* Launch & Market Optimization: Lead end-to-end market entry and expansion strategies, integrating local real-time payment rails and partner networks to maximize transaction speed, cost efficiency, and customer experience.
* Commercial FX & Margin Strategy: Partner closely with internal Pricing, FX Trading, and Treasury teams to continuously optimize corridor pricing models. Drive regional FX spread margins, ensure competitive liquidity across high-volume APAC currency pairs, and maximize overall revenue margins.

* Marketing Teams (multi-channel acquisition and localized growth campaigns)
* Payment Operations Teams (route efficiency, settlement, scaling infrastructure)
* Pricing Teams (dynamic rate management and corridor margins)
* FX Traders (underlying liquidity support and panel coordination)
* Country Directorship & Governance: Concurrently serve as, or oversee, Country Director roles based on business needs, managing local regulatory relationships and government interactions to facilitate seamless market launches.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Report performance metrics, expansion milestones, and revenue updates directly to the ExCo and senior leadership.

Infrastructure, Launch Execution & Risk

* Cross-Functional Delivery: Lead the alignment between Business Development, Launch, Product, and Tech teams to ensure new market rails, APIs, and commercial features are brought to market at pace.
* Operational Scalability: Automate cross-border and operational processes to scale corridor capacity without increasing overhead friction.
* Risk & Regulatory Oversight: Oversee regional commercial and exposure risks, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory standards across all operating entities.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Expansion & Launch Expertise: Demonstrated experience entering new geographies, launching cross-border payment corridors, and building strategic financial or distribution partnerships across APAC.

* APAC Market Mastery: In-depth knowledge of APAC financial markets, payment infrastructure, local regulatory environments, and consumer payment preferences.
* Dealmaking & Negotiation: Exceptional skills in sourcing, structuring, and closing complex, first-in-kind commercial agreements.
* Strategic Drive: An autonomous, highly energetic self-starter with a bias for action and the strategic vision to build a dominant market presence in high-volume corridors.

**AI Literacy & Tools**

* Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Monetization
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
  
YallaPlay is a venture-backed mobile games studio of about 25 people, headquartered in Abu Dhabi with team members in Brazil and Europe. We build and operate card games: our flagship, Spades Masters, has grown consistently for years and is played by millions. We are building toward a portfolio of card games, including Arabic-first titles for the MENA region, operated on one shared technology and LiveOps platform.
  
  
We reinvent classic card and board games with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that bring people together. Small team, big ambition, direct communication.
  
  
Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for a
**Head of Product & Monetization**
to lead the performance, roadmap, execution, and player experience of YallaPlay’s game portfolio.
  
  
You will be the most senior product leader in the company, reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with him on every major product bet. You own what we build and why: product strategy, roadmap, monetization, economy, LiveOps strategy, product requirements, and KPI outcomes across our live games.
  
  
You will lead the Product function and manage the Producer and Art Lead, ensuring Product, Production, and Art are aligned around the right roadmap, clear priorities, strong execution, high quality standards, and measurable game outcomes.
  
  
This is a high-autonomy role. We are looking for someone who forms their own conclusions from data and arrives with proposals, not questions. You will not be judged by the number of documents you produce. You will be judged by the quality of your decisions, the speed of execution, the clarity of priorities, and the measurable improvement of our games.
  
  
This position is based at our offices in Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Remote will be considered for the right candidate with Gulf-hours overlap.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the product roadmap and KPI outcomes for our live titles: revenue, ARPDAU, retention, LTV, conversion, engagement, and economy health.
* Own product discovery, prioritization logic, product requirements, feature rationale, success metrics, and post-launch decisions for major game changes.
* Lead monetization and economy strategy: IAP catalog and pricing, offer segmentation, season passes, VIP programs, collection systems, ad monetization, and the balance between ads and IAP.
* Own the LiveOps strategy across events, offers, seasonal content, player segmentation, and content cadence, ensuring LiveOps is measured and connected to retention, monetization, and long-term game health.
* Guide game systems and product design: progression, rewards, player journeys, UX, economy changes, and monetization experiments, using dashboards, A/B tests, player behavior, and competitor analysis to decide what to build, cut, scale, or rework.
* Manage the Producer and Art Lead, ensuring Product, Production, and Art are aligned with clear ownership, realistic roadmaps, on-time delivery, strong execution, and visual quality that matches the bar of the genre.
* Establish lightweight product discipline: assumption documentation before build, design review gates, KPI reviews after launch, and post-mortems.
* Build the operating rhythm across Product, Production, Art, Engineering, BI, UA, VIP Support, and AdMon: roadmap reviews, LiveOps planning, prioritization, trade-off decisions, and performance follow-ups.
* Identify team gaps, quality issues, process weaknesses, and resourcing needs, and drive practical fixes.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
**What You Need To Have**

* 10+ years in mobile free-to-play games, the majority in product roles on live titles.
* Hands-on monetization systems experience: you have personally designed offer systems, passes, VIP economies, IAP catalogs, or similar systems and can reason about their math in detail.
* Ownership of revenue or retention targets for a live game, with results you can speak to.
* Strong analytical fluency: comfortable in dashboards, cohorts, funnels, and A/B results, and able to pull your own numbers when needed.
* Strong product judgment across game systems, player journeys, progression, rewards, UX, LiveOps, economy, and monetization.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across product, production, design, and art, including managing experienced leads without absorbing their jobs.
* Clear, direct communication in English, and comfort working with a multicultural remote team across time zones.
* Strong execution judgment: able to simplify roadmaps, cut low-value work, resolve trade-offs, and push teams toward measurable outcomes.

**Strong Advantage**

* Depth in card, board, casual, or real-time multiplayer games.
* Experience managing both product and creative/art functions.
* VIP and whale engagement, segmentation, and personalized monetization.
* Ad mediation, placement strategy, and ad revenue optimization.
* Taking games from soft launch to global launch and live operations.
* Familiarity with MENA markets or Arabic.
* Unity and mobile production pipelines; SQL or similar data skills.

The Person Who Will Succeed in This Role
  
  
You are not only a strategist. You are an operator.
  
  
You can look at a dashboard and spot what matters. You can review a roadmap and immediately see what is bloated, weak, or missing. You can sit with artists and discuss visual quality, then move to a KPI review and challenge monetization assumptions. You can tell the CEO what is working, what is not, and what needs to happen next, in two minutes.
  
  
You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. You move fast, but not blindly. You are direct, practical, and accountable. You do not wait for the perfect process before acting.
  
  
Why YallaPlay
  
  
**What You Get**

* A senior compensation package.
* Relocation support and UAE visa sponsorship for Abu Dhabi; remote flexibility for the right candidate.
* Direct partnership with the CEO and genuine decision authority.
* A funded company with multi-year runway and a profitable flagship game.
* The chance to shape a multi-game studio's product practice from the ground up.
* Generous paid time off, your birthday off, and a learning budget.

How We Hire
  
  
Intro conversation, then a product craft deep-dive, then a short practical exercise based on real anonymized product data, then team conversations, references, and offer. We move quickly and tell you where you stand at every step.
  
  
When you apply, please include your CV and, where possible, examples of games, features, LiveOps, monetization systems, or performance improvements you have led.
  
  
*YallaPlay is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and nationalities.*

**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. * **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.

* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

* **Payment Orchestration:** Experience with payment orchestration platforms and routing logic (e.g., cascading, smart routing, retry optimization).

The Middle East and Africa Compliance team is seeking a Vice President, based in Dubai and reporting to the Head of Middle East and Africa Compliance. The Vice President will provide entity-level oversight, including potential registered Compliance Officer or other controlled-function responsibilities as the regional footprint expands, while delivering specialist coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities across GCC jurisdictions.

  

**About Morgan Stanley and the DIFC Branch:**

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm and has served clients in the Middle East and Africa since the early 1970s. From offices in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and Johannesburg, the Firm provides investment banking, capital markets, sales and trading, asset management and private wealth management services. The DIFC Branch forms part of this regional platform, connecting clients to Morgan Stanley's global capabilities and solutions. Our success is underpinned by integrity, excellence and a strong team ethic, providing an environment in which people can learn, achieve and grow.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people are critical to our success. We share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley provides a strong foundation for building a professional career and a place for people to learn, achieve and grow.

  
  

**Department Overview:**

Compliance advises Business Units and staff on applicable laws, regulations, exchange requirements and Firm policies. The Department implements Compliance and Global Financial Crimes policies and procedures, delivers training, undertakes monitoring and surveillance, and partners with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and other control functions to maintain a robust second line of defence.

  

**What you'll do in the role:**

**What you'll bring to the role:**

* Strong knowledge of MENA regulatory frameworks and practical experience in Saudi Arabia and the UAE; familiarity with Qatar and Kuwait is advantageous.

* Experience in regulatory engagement and change, including submissions, inspections and remediation; prior controlled-function experience, or the credibility to assume such responsibilities subject to regulatory approval, is desirable.
* Excellent analytical, drafting and communion skills.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

* **Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.**
* **Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.**
* **Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.**
* **Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).**
* **Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.**

**Business**

* **Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.**
* **Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.**
* **Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.**
* **Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.**
* **Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.**

**Processes**

**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* **Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.**
* **Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.**
* **Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.**
* **Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.**
* **Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.**

**Events & Field Marketing**

* **Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.**
* **Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.**
* **Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.**

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* **Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.**
* **Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.**
* **Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.**
* **Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.**

**Brand & Sales Enablement**

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

jobs.description:
**Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together**

**Our Meaningful Mission**  
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave , driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.
  
  
**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners , always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners , treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**  
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.

Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The UAE Services Business Execution & Strategy Analyst / Associate plays a central role in driving the growth, governance, and operational execution of Citi’s Services franchise in the United Arab Emirates.

  
  

This role blends strategic commercial enablement, product P&L analytics, and sales pipeline optimization with proactive oversight of country governance, regulatory affairs, technology enhancement asks, and executive reporting for UAE leadership.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

**A. UAE Services Strategy & Commercial Growth**

**Strategy Execution:** Execute the comprehensive UAE Services strategy established by Country Management to accelerate business momentum across the franchise.

**Franchise Expansion:** Support growth initiatives across revenue, transaction volume, and balance sheet/asset dimensions across all UAE cash management, payments, and trade lines.

  
  

**B. Product P&L, Financial Analytics & Performance Tracking**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**P&L Management & Measurement:** Monitor, analyze, and report on product-level P&L performance, revenue streams, and expense drivers across all UAE Services offerings.

**Variance & Trend Analysis:** Extract and evaluate financial and balance sheet data from Citi internal systems; compare actual performance against plan and prior periods, pinpointing drivers, growth trends, and outliers.

**Financial Forecasting:** Partner with finance and business managers to assist in quarterly forecasting, annual budget formulation, and productivity reviews.

  
  

**C. Country Governance, Regulatory Affairs & Infrastructure**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Governance Engagement:** Assist the UAE Services Head with relevant data in UAE country governance matters, supporting Services representation on various Country Governance Committees.

  
  

**D. Sales Pipeline & Commercial Enablement**
---------------------------------------------

**Pipeline Coordination:** Coordinate a robust sales pipeline by liaising with coverage bankers, solution sales, and product partners across the UAE.

**Performance Metrics:** Track won/lost deals, deal conversion cycles, and client calling intensity to identify growth bottlenecks and support revenue target achievement.

**E. Executive Presentations, Senior Visits & Action Tracking**
---------------------------------------------------------------

**Executive Decks:** Prepare high-impact PowerPoint presentations and briefing documents for Country Governance Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, and business reviews.

**Senior Leadership Visits:** Coordinate, develop, and synthesize briefing packs and strategic overviews for visiting regional and global executive leaders.

**Action Follow-Through:** Rigorously track and coordinate action items stemming from client engagements, country committee reviews, and regulatory meetings to ensure timely resolution.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

  
  

* Minimum of 3+ years of relevant banking experience (preferably in transaction banking, cash management, trade services, or corporate banking)
* Sound understanding of P&L mechanics, balance sheet analysis, statistical analysis, and variance modeling
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation skills with the ability to synthesize complex commercial, regulatory, and financial data into clean, executive-ready decks
* Strong hands-on proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, data modeling) and MS Word; aptitude for quickly learning internal core banking and CRM platforms
* Fluent written and verbal English communication skills; confident in liaising with cross-functional internal stakeholders and senior management
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail; able to work independently, manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables, and drive tasks to completion
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.
  

  

**What We Offer:**

**Direct Country Franchise Exposure:** High-visibility role with direct access to UAE Services leadership and country governance bodies.

**Workplace Flexibility:** Business casual environment with a hybrid work structure (up to 2 days/week working from home).

**Senior Auditor**

**Overview**
------------

You will work as Senior Auditor under the direction of the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit and the Head of IMI-CIB Foreign Network Audit. Either independently or collectively with the MEA Audit team and with HO auditors, you will carry out or lead internal audit engagements covering different areas; you will evaluate internal controls of the audited organizational structure process, document audit test work and communicate audit issues to management. You will adhere to the obligatory IIA Standards, as well as the methodology standards of the ISP Chief Audit Officer. You will be responsible for the preparation of ad hoc and periodic reports, as requested, and you will be the official point of contact for the Internal Audit function with the local Regulators.

**What you'll be doing**

You will have the opportunity to support the following activities:

* Develop comprehensive and detailed audit program, based on the HO Chief Audit Officer methodology framework, to support the execution of audit tests and verifications

* Ensure the preparation of diligently audit products (reports, work papers, etc.)
* Ensure that the audit reports are prepared in a timely manner and that they clearly present the identified weaknesses and formulate effective recommendations for mitigation action
* Ensure the efficient monitoring of the resolution of the identified weaknesses and the implementation of mitigation actions
* Follow the evolution of the business and operational activities and of the credit portfolio of the Branch, as well as the changes in the related internal (local and HO) and external regulations
* Maintain solid working relationships with relevant Branch counterparties and stakeholders
* Manage the relationship with the local Regulators, answer their enquiries in collaboration with the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit and with the Head of IMI CIB Foreign Network Audit

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

If you want to turn your passion into a career and you have the following characteristics, we are waiting for you:
