jobs.description:
Date live: 11/10/2026

Business Area: See job description

Area of Expertise: Early Careers

Contract: Intern

Reference Code: JR-0000125149

  

**Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for the global markets division.
* Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.
* Training and mentoring of junior colleagues.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation’s products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Vice President - International Gaming Compliance & MLRO
jobs.description:
About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.

About the Position:

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a **Vice President – Gaming Compliance & Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)** to join the resort’s **Gaming Compliance team** in Ras Al Khaimah. The role reports directly to the Chief Global Compliance Officer, Wynn Resorts, and administratively to the SVP, General Counsel, WMI.

As MLRO and a senior leader within Gaming Compliance, you will direct the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of WMI’s risk-based Anti-Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) Compliance Program. You will oversee suspicious activity investigations and reporting to the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit (UAE FIU) through goAML, set risk appetite and control standards, lead training, and provide strategic direction to Gaming Compliance teams and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents. The program covers applicable UAE Federal AML laws, Cabinet Decisions, Chapter 12 of the GCGRA Executive Regulations, and FATF standards applicable to Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs).

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

* Act as WMI’s MLRO, reviewing and determining Suspicious Activity Incident Reports (SAIRs), escalating and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), ensuring continuity through an appropriately qualified Deputy MLRO during any absence, and serving as Secretary of the WMI AML Compliance Committee.
* Provide strategic leadership and direction to Gaming Compliance, setting objectives, policies, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and business goals.
* Oversee AML/CFT obligations and maintain effective compliance systems, controls, and governance to minimize exposure to money laundering and terrorism financing.
* Direct and review suspicious activity investigations, analysis, and escalation, with direct reporting to the WMI AML Compliance Committee and governing body. Make timely, documented reporting or non-reporting decisions, prioritize cases by risk, and maintain confidentiality and independence.
* Oversee timely SAR filing with the UAE FIU through goAML, no later than 30 calendar days from initial detection, and ensure the GCGRA is notified of the FIU reference number immediately following submission.
* Oversee Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), source of funds and source of wealth verification, and risk scoring for potentially high-risk patrons and Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), approving risk-based decisions.
* Develop and maintain quality assurance (QA) policies, procedures, and review standards for SARs, CDD and EDD files, transaction monitoring alerts, and investigations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with GCGRA requirements.
* Conduct comprehensive QA testing to identify trends, gaps, and errors, and recommend corrective actions and improvements to strengthen the AML Compliance Program.
* Prepare QA reports, metrics, analytical findings, and enhancement updates for leadership, the WMI AML Compliance Committee, and the Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Maintain robust AML/CFT recordkeeping and storage for a minimum of five years, in accordance with the GCGRA Executive Regulations, with records immediately available to the GCGRA or UAE authorities upon request.
* Oversee regular screening of persons reported in SAIRs/SARs, currency exchanges, and third-party wire transfers, and review the monthly PEP checklist prepared for Global Compliance Investigations.
* Work closely with Wynn Resorts Global Compliance Investigations to prepare and review reports for the WMI AML Compliance Committee and Patron AML Restriction Committee.
* Lead GCGRA examinations, internal audits, and annual independent AML Compliance Program testing; act as a primary regulatory contact and oversee remediation of deficiencies.
* Cooperate with the GCGRA, UAE FIU, Police, and Courts, managing responses to investigation inquiries and regulatory or law enforcement information requests.
* Oversee ongoing sanctions screening of players, transactions, and vendors against UAE and relevant UN Security Council sanctions lists, including match handling, escalation, freezing measures, reporting, and recordkeeping; ensure Targeted Financial Sanctions are applied when a match is identified.
* Oversee daily transaction monitoring, transaction logs, and Electronic Multiple Transaction Logs (e-MTLs), ensuring loggable and reportable transactions at or above AED 11,000 are accurately recorded and structuring or other suspicious activity is identified and escalated.
* Design and implement monitored risk scenarios and typologies, overseeing alert handling, escalation, investigation, system tuning, and transaction monitoring effectiveness.
* Enforce the prohibition on anonymous, alias/AKA, fictitious-name, and nominee Player Accounts, and ensure identification and account-opening due diligence requirements are met.
* Enforce strict confidentiality of SARs and suspicious activity investigations and the prohibition on tipping off, sharing SAR information only on a need-to-know basis in accordance with UAE law.
* Direct WMI’s annual money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risk assessment, using results to enhance policies, procedures, systems, and controls.
* Report clearly and promptly to senior management and governing bodies on AML/CFT/CPF program effectiveness, maintaining governance that upholds confidentiality and independence.
* Keep the Compliance Program current with evolving risks, typologies, legislation, regulatory guidance, sanctions requirements, products, services, and emerging technologies.
* Develop, deliver, and maintain AML/CFT/CPF training, including role-targeted programs, materials, and records; coach managers, staff, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents on regulatory obligations.
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage Gaming Compliance managers and team members.
* Build professional, positive relationships with department heads, team members, regulators, and Gaming Promoters/Independent Agents.
* Attend and lead departmental and interdepartmental meetings and share relevant information.
* Adhere to Company policies, procedures, and the Code of Conduct.
* Maintain professional conduct and grooming in line with Department and Company standards.
* Follow health and safety standards and pursue continuous improvement to prevent health and injury hazards.
* Undertake other duties and responsibilities typical of a VP-level role at WMI.

About You:

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* **Experience:** At least 10 years of experience in AML/CFT/CPF compliance, gaming compliance, or a related field, including at least five years in senior management or a director-level role, with sufficient authority, direct access to governing bodies, and the independence to challenge business decisions.
* **Operational MLRO experience:** Advanced, senior-level operational MLRO experience in a large, complex, cash- and/or value-intensive environment, relevant to WMI’s land-based casino business model, transaction profile, customer base, and ML/TF/PF risks.
* **Preferred experience:** Experience in UAE financial institutions or regulated entities, goAML and UAE FIU reporting, GCGRA requirements, the UAE AML/CFT/CPF framework and regulatory environment, and commercial gaming.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Fina

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insigh

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Pine Labs is seeking a dynamic B2C marketing leader to drive consumer adoption of our fintech products through integrated marketing campaigns and innovative in-store activation. This role owns the end-to-end consumer journey—from digital discovery to in-store transaction—making affordability and smart payment solutions accessible and desirable to millions of Indian consumers.

**As the Lead for B2C Marketing & Consumer Activation, you will build Pine Labs into a household name for Gen Z and Millennial consumers seeking flexible payment options.**
You'll craft compelling fintech narratives that demystify complex products, drive app adoption, and create memorable in-store experiences that convert browsers into users at the moment of purchase.

**What You'll Own**

**Consumer Brand Building & Integrated Campaigns**

* Develop and execute 360-degree integrated marketing campaigns that connect digital touchpoints (social, app, performance marketing) with physical retail experiences
* Own the consumer narrative for Pine Labs' affordability ecosystem—EMI, Pay Later, consumer cards, and wallet products—translating fintech complexity into simple, relatable stories
* Build category leadership by creating the "Halo Effect" that positions Pine Labs as the smart choice for aspirational consumption
* Drive always-on brand campaigns and high-impact moment marketing that keeps Pine Labs top-of-mind for young consumers

**App Marketing & Digital Consumer Acquisition**

* Lead consumer app marketing strategy—from acquisition to activation, engagement, and retention
* Design app onboarding journeys, push notification strategies, and in-app campaigns that drive feature adoption and transaction frequency
* Partner with Performance Marketing teams to optimise digital spend across Meta, Google, and emerging channels for consumer acquisition
* Build growth loops that turn one-time users into habitual consumers of Pine Labs products

**In-Store Consumer Activation & Experiential Marketing**

* Design and execute high-impact in-store activation programs that educate and convert consumers at the point of purchase
* Create experiential marketing initiatives—pop-ups, brand activations, merchant location takeovers—that drive trial and adoption
* Build "phygital" experiences that seamlessly connect app downloads, wallet loading, and in-store transactions
* Develop merchant partnership programs where Pine Labs creates value for both retailers and end consumers through co-created experiences

**Consumer Lifecycle & Engagement Marketing**

* Own the post-acquisition consumer journey—designing lifecycle marketing programs (email, SMS, WhatsApp, push) that drive repeat usage
* Build segmentation strategies that deliver personalized messaging based on consumer behavior, transaction patterns, and life stage
* Create nudge marketing frameworks that increase transaction frequency and basket size
* Design loyalty and rewards programs that increase wallet share and consumer lifetime value

**Partnership Marketing & Co-Branded Campaigns**

* Develop strategic partnerships with consumer brands (electronics, fashion, travel) to create co-branded campaigns that drive mutual value
* Design "brand as a utility" partnerships where Pine Labs' affordability products enhance consumer access to aspirational brands
* Build influencer and content creator programs that authentically showcase Pine Labs use cases to target audiences

**What We're Looking For**

* 10 -15+ years in B2C marketing with at least 5+ years in consumer fintech, digital payments, or consumer-facing financial services
* Proven track record of scaling consumer apps and driving adoption of digital financial products in India
* Deep experience with integrated marketing campaigns that blend digital performance marketing with offline/experiential activation
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, purchase psychology, and the affordability mindset in India

**Core Capabilities**

*Consumer Insight & Market Synthesis*

* Deep empathy for Gen Z and Millennial financial behaviours, aspirations, and anxieties around credit and affordability
* Ability to identify cultural moments, consumer trends, and behavioral shifts before they become mainstream
* Track record of translating complex fintech products into relatable consumer propositions that drive trial

*Digital Marketing Excellence*

* Strong command of app marketing—ASO, UA campaigns, onboarding optimization, retention mechanics
* Experience with performance marketing optimization, cohort analysis, and growth experimentation
* Understanding of consumer data platforms, marketing automation, and personalization at scale
* Comfort with analytics—can diagnose funnel drop-offs and design interventions based on data

*Campaign Architecture & Storytelling*

* Ability to design multi-channel integrated campaigns with a clear consumer journey from awareness to transaction
* Strong creative judgment—can evaluate and elevate creative work from agencies and internal studios
* Narrative design skills that make financial products emotionally compelling, not just functionally useful
* Experience creating viral-worthy social content and culturally resonant brand moments

*Experiential Marketing & Activation*

* Experience designing and executing consumer activations in retail environments, campuses, events, and festivals
* Understanding of how to create Instagram-worthy brand experiences that generate earned media
* Ability to measure the impact of experiential marketing on brand metrics and downstream transactions
* Creative approach to "phygital" experiences that bridge online engagement and offline action

*Strategic Orchestration & Influence*

* Can align Product, Sales, Business, and Creative teams around a unified consumer vision without direct authority
* Experience managing multiple agency partners (creative, media, experiential, PR) toward cohesive output
* Ability to build business cases that secure budget and resources for high-impact consumer initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management—can navigate organisational complexity and drive consensus

**Why Pine Labs**

Join us at an inflection point where fintech meets mass consumer adoption. You'll have the opportunity to introduce millions of first-time users to smart financial products that unlock aspirational consumption. Pine Labs processes tens of billions in transaction value annually—your campaigns will directly shape how a generation of Indian consumers discovers, adopts, and evangelizes new ways to pay. You'll work at the intersection of brand, product, and growth—a rare opportunity to build a category-defining consumer fintech brand.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Dostt )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)
* **Astrology Guidance**  - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* **Edutainment Skill Learning**  - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* **Matrimonial Matchmaking**  - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* **Agri Consulting**  - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* **Local Jobs**  - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* **Social Community**  - Place to find post social updates (Lokal app)
* **Advisory Services**  - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

**About the Team:**  The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our house of apps model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. Youll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy-working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

**Responsibilities:**

+ **Drive product strategy**  to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
+ **Own and enhance payment systems**  by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
+ **Design and run pricing experiments**  including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
+ **Collaborate with Marketing**  to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
+ **Strengthen trust and user satisfaction**  by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
+ **Partner cross-functionally**  with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
+ **Own the product roadmap**  , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
+ **Conduct market research**  to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
+ **Develop retention strategies**  to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
+ **Analyze user behavior**  and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

**What We re Looking For:**

+ 5 - 9 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
+ Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
+ Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
+ Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
+ Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. Were outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

  
  
This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves
  
  
Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: MRGR Review Lead - Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
* Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
* Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
* Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
* Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
* Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
* Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
* Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.
* Contribute to model risk governance and review priorities and initiatives.
* Stay informed about changes in consumer banking, artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques (including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence), products, markets, models, risk practices, and industry standards; use this knowledge to guide review priorities and identify emerging risks.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a strong quantitative background (PhD, Master's degree, or equivalent) in Statistics, Economics (with Econometrics), Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a quantitative science.
* Knowledge of both statistical/econometric methodologies and machine learning modeling methodologies.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, SAS, or R.
* Working knowledge of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques, including large language models, generative artificial intelligence, and agentic artificial intelligence systems, including key risks and limitations.
* Ability to challenge model design, assumptions, and testing approaches for advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models.
* Product domain expertise in consumer banking/retail banking, including ability to understand the business and knowledge of regulation surrounding the business.
* Extensive experience and familiarity in model development or model validation in financial institutions.
* 12+ years of work experience in model development or model validation.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to interface with stakeholders on model-related issues.
* Risk and control mindset: ask incisive questions, assess materiality of issues, and escalate as required.
* Sound project management and organizational skills; flexible and adaptable to shifting priorities, and able to work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Director - Innovation, Menu & Markets - KFC MENA
jobs.description:
**Location: Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah(Border of Dubai & Sharjah)**

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Key Responsibility Areas:**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.
* Develop and execute an overarching marketing AOP that delivers on the brand’s strategic objectives across the geography.

**Market Windows & Execution Excellence: Own the local calendar, end to end**

* Own the planning and execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market (e.g. Ramadan, Eid, National Days, summer, back-to-school and key sporting and cultural moments), tailoring offer, price and communication to each market.
* Deliver flawless, on-time launches from concept to restaurant, covering product readiness, supply, training, POS, digital and aggregator activation, and close gaps with speed and minimal escalation.
* Run a disciplined launch cadence with clear timelines, owners and post-launch reviews; read results fast, fix what is not working and scale what is.
* Maintain a strong, hands-on presence in markets and restaurants to ensure plans land as intended and learnings are captured and shared across markets.

**Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and get things done**

* Drive cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders, including but not limited to the Franchisor, country GMs and Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Procurement and other business units, to deliver cohesive and impactful NPD and market initiatives.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with country leadership teams; balance regional consistency with local market needs and negotiate trade-offs to land the best outcome for the brand.
* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Continue to deliver industry-leading financial outcomes.
* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.
* Work with cross-functional teams to build a strong data- and learning-based marketing investment culture.

**Insights and Analytics: Role-model the use of data, while staying curious to spot trends that future-proof the brand**

* Use consumer research programs to refine the consumer model, conduct competitor analysis, track consumer habits and initiate product improvements to meet market needs.
* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.
* Be a flag bearer for Americana’s purpose, vision and strategy, instilling an ownership mindset and a bias for action.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 10–15 years of marketing leadership experience.
* Experience in QSR or retail is a must-have.
* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.
* A strong food palate and genuine passion for food, with hands-on experience in menu management, NPD and product sign-off.
* Expertise in building brand love to drive both customer penetration and frequency.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, the franchisor, country teams and cross-functional partners.
* A hustler mindset: hands-on, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity and driven to get things done at pace.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to interpret and act on data insights.
* Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to build future leaders while driving performance in cross-functional teams.

**Description**
---------------

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.

* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.

jobs.title: Vice President- Retail Credit Policy
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.
  
• Develop granular customer, product, channel, employer, income and behavioral segmentation to identify growth pockets, emerging risks and differentiated treatment strategies.
  
• Design and govern risk decision frameworks covering eligibility, score cut-offs, affordability, limits, tenor, pricing, line management, cross-sell, collections and exit strategies.
  
• Lead champion–challenger tests and controlled experiments; define success metrics, guardrails and post-implementation monitoring to scale profitable strategies safely.
  
• Partner with data science teams to develop, validate and deploy application, behavioral, propensity, fraud and early-warning models using traditional and alternative data.
  
• Establish responsible AI and model governance, including explainability, fairness, drift, stability, override, monitoring and human-oversight standards.
  
• Build executive dashboards, forecasts and scenario analyses linking risk drivers to revenue, margin, credit cost, operating expense, capital and lifetime customer profitability.
  
• Define early-warning indicators, portfolio triggers and remediation playbooks for adverse trends, concentration risks and macroeconomic or market shocks.
  
• Provide independent retail credit risk challenge for new products, partnerships, fintech propositions and material changes to customer journeys or decision engines.
  
• Ensure compliance with Central Bank requirements, internal policies, model risk standards, consumer protection expectations and audit requirements.
  
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing portfolio analytics team and strengthen data-driven decision making across Retail Banking.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
• Experience: Typically 12–15 years in retail credit risk, portfolio management or risk analytics, including substantial leadership responsibility and direct exposure to credit cards, personal loans and digital lending/BNPL.
  
• Portfolio expertise: Proven ownership of acquisition and account-management strategies, vintages, roll rates, delinquency, loss forecasting, provisions, risk-adjusted profitability, limit management, collections strategies and portfolio optimization.
  
• Analytics and modeling: Strong command of statistical analysis, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, scorecards and AI/ML applications across underwriting, behavioral risk, propensity, fraud and early warning.
  
• Technical capability: Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python, R or SAS; strong working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, large datasets, data pipelines and cloud analytics environments.
  
• Decision frameworks: Demonstrated ability to translate analytics into executable cut-offs, pricing, limits, treatments and growth strategies with clear economics, controls and performance measurement.
  
• Governance: Sound understanding of model risk, responsible AI, explainability, fairness, data privacy, consumer protection, IFRS 9/provisioning concepts and Central Bank requirements relevant to retail lending.
  
• Leadership: Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and people leadership, with the ability to challenge constructively and present complex risk-return choices to senior committees.

jobs.title: Gen AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases
