KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.

* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.

**Head of Business Technology Intelligence**
.

The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.
  
  
The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Director, Software Engineering
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, building digital platforms that securely power commerce at global scale. Our technology enables innovation across financial services, data, AI, and digital experiences, while maintaining the highest standards of reliability, security, and trust.
  
  
Role
  
  
Business & Market Insights (B&MI) is Mastercard’s data, analytics, and intelligence organization, responsible for transforming vast, global data assets into actionable insights and decision support products for customers across industries. B&MI builds platforms and products that move beyond static analytics, embedding AI, advanced modeling, and increasingly agentic systems directly into customer workflows to help clients understand what is happening, what will happen next, and what actions to take. The team operates on a global scale, where product, engineering, and data teams come together to deliver secure, governed, and production ready intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

* 7+ years of full stack engineering experience in an agile production environment
* 2+ years managing two or more engineering teams and coaching and mentoring emerging leaders
* Experience leading the architecture, design, implementation, and release of complex products and applications that spans across multiple engineering teams
* Strong backend engineering experience using languages such as Java, Kotlin, Python, Scala, or similar technologies
* Familiarity with cloud technologies and platforms, including but not limited to AWS EMR, Aurora, Databricks, and Snowflake, used to build and scale data-intensive applications
* Strong technologist with proven track record of learning new technologies and frameworks
* Relentless focus on and track record of delivering value for customers
* Strong analytical / quantitative problem-solving skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

Credit Saison India is committed to growing as a lender and evolving its offerings in India for the long-term for MSMEs, households, individuals and more. Saison International is the international headquarters (IHQ) of Credit Saison Company Limited, founded in 1951 and one of Japan’s largest lending conglomerates with over 70 years of history and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. * Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.

**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI and Data Lead
jobs.description:
**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Data and AI Lead who is passionate about turning data into products and decisions, and wants to work in a disruptive, fast-growing and exciting environment. Every transaction on our network tells us something about what customers want, which products perform in which markets and how our partners can grow. This role will bring that intelligence together and put it to work across the business.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working closely with the leadership team, product, engineering and commercial teams, you will set the direction for how DT One uses data, analytics and AI, build the team to deliver it, and make sure it has a measurable impact on growth and profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, commercially minded leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own data and AI end to end, from strategy and platforms through to the products, insights and automation that our teams and partners use every day.
  
  

* Define and drive the data and AI strategy and roadmap, making sure it is aligned with commercial, product and technology priorities
* Build, lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team across data engineering, data science and machine learning, analytics and data governance
* Own the data platform, bringing together transaction, product and partner data into a trusted, scalable foundation for real-time and batch analytics
* Deliver data and AI products that drive growth, such as product recommendations, pricing and demand insights, partner performance analytics, and fraud and anomaly detection
* Lead the adoption of AI, including generative AI, to automate operations and improve decision-making across the business
* Establish data governance, quality, privacy and compliance standards that work across multiple markets and regulatory environments
* Partner with the leadership team and business units to prioritise use cases, measure value delivered and manage the data and AI budget
* Act as a senior voice for data and AI with partners and the wider Thunes group

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience in data, analytics and machine learning, including several years leading data and AI functions
* Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience
* A proven record of building and scaling multi-disciplinary data teams, including across multiple countries
* Experience delivering data platforms and data products at scale in digital, e-commerce, fintech or other high-volume consumer businesses
* Hands-on depth in applied machine learning in production, such as personalisation, recommendation, forecasting or customer analytics
* Experience setting up data governance and working with data privacy requirements across multiple jurisdictions
* The ability to translate business goals into a clear data roadmap, and to communicate with and influence senior stakeholders
* Experience with fintech, payments or mobile data, or with deploying generative AI in production, is a plus
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

Our core services tech stack is hosted on Amazon Web Services.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will build and manage a growth system based on data, AI, and user intent, transforming marketing from a communication function into a real-time decision layer. We provide the space for you to exercise true strategic autonomy, stripping away micromanagement so you can integrate marketing directly into the product, drive user acquisition and retention through intent detection, and evolve UMO into a trusted financial assistant end-to-end.

**You'll take ownership of:**

* **Growth & Decision Layer (The Core):**
  Build an intent detection and decisioning system based on user data. Integrate marketing directly into the product (product-led growth) to drive "one intent -> one action" logic, shaping the user's experience by correctly reacting to their state in the moment.
* **Data & MarTech Architecture:**
  Build our first-party data strategy, developing the CDP, data layer, event tracking, and data clean rooms while maintaining data quality, structure, and accessibility for automated decisioning.
* **Customer Lifecycle & Personalization:**
  Design the end-to-end customer journey, transitioning from traditional segments to individual scenarios powered by behavior, context, financial status, and life event triggers.
* **Go-to-Market & Growth Execution:**
  Develop GTM strategies for new products and markets while managing performance, partnership, and product-led acquisition channels focused on LTV, engagement, and value delivered.
* **Brand & Trust:**
  Shape UMO's positioning as an AI-native financial assistant and trusted decision layer, ensuring absolute communication consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* **Compliance & Data Governance:**
  Ensure strict compliance with GDPR, privacy rules, advertising standards, and consent management frameworks in close coordination with CISO, Risk, and Legal teams.
* **Analytics & Intelligence:**
  Build a real-time metrics system measuring intent detection accuracy, context conversions, LTV, retention, and value delivered.
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Lead Growth, Data, Marketing, and CRM/Lifecycle teams while partnering closely with Product, Tech, AI, Risk, and Compliance.

**About you:**

* **Executive Growth Leadership:**
  You have extensive commercial experience in a senior marketing or growth leadership capacity (at least 7+ years) within high-growth fintech, tech, or data-driven digital environments.
* **Data & AI-Native Architecture:**
  You feel at home building first-party data strategies, CDPs, and event-tracking frameworks, leveraging AI tooling and predictive models to turn raw data into actionable decision engines.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG) Depth:**
  You have proven experience driving acquisition, engagement, and retention directly through product workflows rather than relying solely on external ad campaigns.
* **Regulated Environment & Compliance:**
  You understand data protection principles, GDPR, advertising regulations, and consent governance, ensuring data is used transparently and in the user's best interest.
* **Autonomous Milestone Execution:**
  You manage complex growth goals comfortably, taking complete end-to-end problem ownership over market entry, LTV metrics, and product-led journeys.
* **Transparent & Supportive Leadership:**
  You communicate openly, foster cross-functional collaboration with product and tech teams, and prioritize an absolute zero-tolerance policy for rudeness or politics.
* **Linguistic Fluency:**
  You speak and write English fluently to comfortably lead global teams and align cross-functional executive tracks.

**Can get you a few bonus points:**

* **Fintech & Digital Asset Background:**
  Prior experience building growth systems or personalized financial products within fintech, neobanks, or regulated web3 platforms.
* **MarTech & AI Tooling Expertise:**
  Direct experience configuring advanced CDP platforms, custom LLM prompt setups, or AI-driven marketing automation engines.
* **Startup Agility:**
  Experience operating within zero-to-one or lean startup environments where market entry strategies evolve quickly.

**The UMO Standard**

* Mandate & Ownership: Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* Equity: A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* Location & Flexibility: Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

YubiLoans UAE is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to lead the SME Loans Segment. This role is central to driving the growth of our SME marketplace by acquiring corporate borrowers and successfully onboarding them onto our platform. As the Team Leader, you will manage a team responsible for identifying, engaging, and facilitating the onboarding of SME borrowers, ensuring they can connect with the right lenders through our marketplace. You will be at the forefront of shaping the acquisition strategy, ensuring the smooth onboarding of borrowers, and building strong relationships with potential clients. This role requires a leader with a deep understanding of the SME lending landscape, excellent team management skills, and the ability to drive marketplace growth through strategic partnerships and efficient processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership & Team Management:**

* **Team Leadership**
  : Lead and inspire a team of SME loan acquisition specialists and onboarding managers, ensuring they meet loan origination targets and contribute to the growth of Yubiloans' SME borrower base across all SME loan variants including business loans, POS loans, asset backed loans, commercial vehicle and fleet finance, working capital loans, loan against property and capex loans.
* **Performance Management**

* **Coaching & Development**
  : Develop a high-performance culture, providing ongoing training and development to enhance the skill sets of your team members.

* **Onboarding Process**
  : Oversee the seamless onboarding of borrowers onto the Yubiloans platform, ensuring they are fully equipped to access financing options that best meet their needs.
* **Sales Strategy**
  : Develop and implement strategies to acquire a diverse set of borrowers, balancing volume with quality to maximize the overall growth and health of the marketplace.

**Partnership & Relationship Management:**

* **Lender Network Collaboration**
  : Collaborate closely with Yubiloans' lender partners to understand their requirements and ensure the borrowers you onboard are well-matched with appropriate lenders.

  : Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate clients, industry associations, and other stakeholders to attract new borrowers to the platform.

  : Ensure a high-quality onboarding experience for borrowers, guiding them through the platform and answering questions to ensure smooth adoption.

**Operational Excellence:**

* **Process Optimization**
  : Work closely with operations, product, and technology teams to continuously refine and streamline the borrower onboarding process for greater efficiency and scalability.
* **Market Insights & Trends**
  : Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes in the SME lending space to refine acquisition strategies and ensure compliance.
* **Data-Driven Decisions**
  : Utilize data and performance metrics to inform strategies and track the effectiveness of borrower acquisition and onboarding efforts. Identify opportunities for process improvements.

**Client and Stakeholder Interaction:**

* **Client Consultation**
  : Provide advisory support to borrowers, helping them understand the benefits of connecting with the right lenders through Yubiloans and ensuring they are informed and confident throughout the onboarding journey.
* **Cross-Sell & Upsell Opportunities**
  : Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell additional services or products to existing borrowers, enhancing their experience on the platform and increasing lifetime value.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* **Internal Coordination**
  : Collaborate with internal teams such as product, legal, compliance, marketing, and technology to ensure the smooth onboarding of borrowers and continuous improvements to the platform’s functionality and user experience.
* **Market Insights**
  : Provide feedback to the product and marketing teams to ensure that the platform features and promotional strategies align with market demands and borrower needs.

**Key Performance Metrics:**

* **Borrower Acquisition**
  : Achieve new borrower onboarding targets, ensuring a diverse and high-quality pool of SME and Corporate borrowers on the platform.

  : Monitor and optimize the borrower onboarding process, ensuring timely and efficient onboarding experiences.
* **Team Performance**
  : Drive team performance, ensuring KPIs related to borrower engagement, conversion rates, and platform adoption are met.
* **Lender Match Success**
  : Ensure borrowers are successfully matched with the right lenders, contributing to successful loan transactions on the platform.
* **Customer Satisfaction**
  : Track borrower satisfaction and retention, ensuring a high-quality experience throughout the onboarding process.

**Requirements:**

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* **Experience**
  : 8-12 years of experience in the SME lending, fintech, or financial services sectors, with at least 3-5 years in a team management role focused on borrower acquisition, onboarding, or relationship management.
* **Leadership**
  : Proven ability to lead and inspire high-performing teams, with strong people management and coaching skills.
* **Business Development**
  : Experience in driving business development within the SME lending space, with a focus on building relationships with borrowers and lenders.
* **Market Knowledge**
  : Strong understanding of the SME lending landscape in the MENA region, including the needs of corporate borrowers and the dynamics of lending marketplaces.

  : A Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

  : Ability to develop and execute strategic plans to grow borrower acquisition and platform adoption.
* **Client-Centric**
  : A customer-first mindset, with the ability to build trust and strong relationships with SME borrowers and lender partners.
* **Communication**
  : Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with corporate borrowers, lenders, and internal teams.
* **Problem-Solving**
  : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address borrower challenges and optimize the onboarding experience.
* **Technologically Savvy**
  : Familiarity with digital lending platforms, SaaS solutions, and marketplace models. Comfort with using data and technology to drive decision-making.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.

They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.

Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.

The ability to scale delivery successfully depends not only on capacity but on maintaining the quality, expertise, and consulting rigor that clients expect from VCA.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring that VCA-X delivers consistent, high-quality outputs while building the specialist and consulting capability required to support future growth. **Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: ED - Head, Margin & Collateral Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director – Global Head, Margin and Collateral Operations is accountable for the global end-to-end delivery, control and transformation of the Bank’s uncleared margin and collateral franchise across non-centrally cleared derivatives, repo, securities borrowing and lending, structured financing, commodities, precious metals and other collateralised businesses.
* The role owns Initial Margin, Variation Margin, Independent Amount, portfolio reconciliation, dispute management, collateral allocation, settlement, interest, static data, reconciliations, reporting and exception management across the full lifecycle—from legal-agreement and counterparty onboarding through daily exposure calculation, margin exchange and collateral return.
* The role ensures compliance with applicable uncleared margin, segregation, portfolio-reconciliation, dispute-reporting, client-asset, liquidity and books-and-records obligations across all relevant jurisdictions and legal entities, and is accountable for timely, evidenced delivery of regulatory, audit, assurance and risk-remediation commitments.
* The role leads the global target operating model, people strategy and investment roadmap to deliver upcoming global and local margin regulations, maintain compliance with existing requirements through adequate preventive and detective controls, and resolve conflicts between global standards and local regulatory, legal-entity, currency, custody and settlement obligations. The role is accountable for evolving MARS into the Bank’s strategic straight-through and zero-touch collateral management solution, enabling artificial intelligence and effective integration with industry utilities and vendors, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, while supporting digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto and other new-business requirements across Asia and the wider Bank.

Strategy
  
  

* Define and execute the global strategy for uncleared Margin and Collateral Operations, aligned with Global Markets Operations, business growth, counterparty credit-risk mitigation, liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Own the forward regulatory roadmap for global and local margin reforms, translating emerging rules into coordinated legal, client, model, process, technology, custody, settlement, finance and control deliverables while sustaining compliance with existing regulations.
* Establish a scalable target operating model with global process ownership, follow-the-sun delivery, resilient location strategy, clear service segmentation and effective capacity planning.
* Set the strategic direction for MARS as the Bank’s authoritative collateral management platform, delivering end-to-end straight-through processing and zero-touch processing across calculation, margin exchange, allocation, settlement, reconciliation, reporting and exception management.
* Own the multi-year transformation and investment roadmap for standardisation, artificial intelligence, real-time settlement transparency, collateral optimisation, common data, strategic platform integration and controlled decommissioning of legacy processes and systems without service or control degradation.
* Establish strategic partnerships and interoperable solutions with global vendors and industry utilities, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, to increase automation, strengthen portfolio reconciliation and dispute management, and support exception-led operations.
* Set measurable outcomes covering regulatory compliance, margin timeliness, settlement success, disputes, reconciliations, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, client service, collateral utilisation, funding efficiency and financial-data accuracy.
* Anticipate regulatory, market, product and infrastructure developments and ensure the operating model remains controlled, scalable and fit for global flow business and complex local or bespoke requirements.

Business
  
  

* Act as the senior global Operations owner for uncleared margin and collateral services, maintaining effective service across products, legal entities, regions and client segments.
* Partner with Trading, XVA, Treasury, Repo, Prime, Product, Sales and Client Coverage to enable new clients, products, markets and bespoke structures with transparent operational readiness, risk assessment, approvals, capacity and controls.
* Lead the operational enablement of digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto, crypto spot, crypto derivatives and other emerging business propositions, ensuring appropriate agreement structures, segregated or cross-service margin treatment, settlement, custody, valuation, reconciliation, reporting and risk controls.
* Support the Bank’s growth across diverse Asian markets by delivering scalable solutions for local currencies, local custodians, domestic settlement infrastructure, country-specific collateral rules and bespoke regulatory margin requirements.
* Protect the Bank from counterparty credit, liquidity, market, conduct, operational, regulatory and reputational impacts arising from ineffective margining, collateralisation, disputes or settlement.
* Maximise utilisation of the Bank’s collateral inventory through eligibility, concentration, substitutions, intragroup margining, cross-product opportunities and cheapest-to-deliver allocation, while ensuring optimal funding, liquidity, legal-entity and regulatory outcomes.
* Represent Margin and Collateral Operations in senior business, client, risk, governance, audit and investment forums, providing clear decisions and escalation on material matters.

**Processes**

* Own the global control and service framework for agreement onboarding and static data; trade and valuation feeds; IM, VM and Independent Amount calculation; SIMM; margin issuance and response; dispute investigation; collateral selection and movement; interest; substitutions; returns; reconciliations; and reporting.
* Ensure margin calls and collateral movements are complete, accurate, timely and consistent with legal terms, credit requirements, settlement instructions, eligibility schedules, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, haircuts and concentration limits.
* Deliver change for new and amended global margin regulations and local addenda, including impact assessment, requirements interpretation, controls, documentation, client repapering, model approval, custody and settlement readiness, testing, training, implementation and post-go-live assurance.
* Design and operate a defensible framework for conflicting global and local requirements, with documented rule hierarchy, legal and compliance interpretation, country-specific configurations, approvals, traceability and evidence that each applicable obligation is met.
* Enhance MARS and its upstream and downstream interfaces to enable STP and ZTP processing, AI-supported ingestion and exception analysis, real-time connectivity with TriOptima and AcadiaSoft where appropriate, and controlled handling of clients or markets that cannot use industry utilities.
* Provide real-time or near-real-time settlement status for cash and securities, with end-to-end acknowledgement, fail management, aged-item escalation and reconciled views across MARS, settlement platforms, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely feeds of collateral positions, valuations, movements, interest, encumbrance and accounting attributes to Finance, Aspire and other downstream liquidity, ledger, regulatory and management-reporting systems, supported by controls and reconciliations.
* Maintain a robust portfolio-reconciliation and dispute-management model with risk-based prioritisation, ageing, escalation, regulatory reporting and accountable root-cause remediation.
* Establish complete reconciliations across margin systems, trade platforms, settlement systems, Finance, Aspire, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records; ensure all breaks are risk-assessed, owned, aged and resolved with

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. **Job Summary**
Responsible for managing multiple functions within Analytics & Insights, providing leadership and guidance to subordinate managers. Accountable for the execution of strategic business initiatives, operating model effectiveness, governance, client change management, reporting strategy, and productivity programs supporting Performance and Front Office Solutions services.
  
  
As a member of the A&I Senior Leadership Team, participates in developing strategic plans for the business unit and establishes goals and priorities aligned with organizational objectives. Ensures resources are available to accomplish priorities, manages departmental budgets and staffing decisions, and is accountable for performance management and career development within the function.
  
  
Directly provides input leadership and guidance to staff, fostering an environment that encourages employee engagement, teamwork, communication, continuous improvement, and innovation.
  
  
**Major Duties**

* Ensure business partners and clients are fully supported on a day-to-day operational and strategic level, with requirements, issues, and opportunities are addressed effectively.

* Lead the execution of reporting, analytics, governance, productivity, automation, and operating model initiatives designed to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability.
* Establish governance frameworks, management reporting, performance metrics, and oversight processes to support global business objectives and executive decision-making.
* Focus on execution of the strategic direction of business function activities, ensuring successful delivery of business priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Carry out complex initiatives involving multiple disciplines, global stakeholders, competing priorities, and ambiguous business challenges.
* Display a balanced, cross-functional perspective, partnering across the A&I business and its stakeholders to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity.
* Drive identification and implementation of process improvements, automation opportunities, and operating model enhancements that support long-term business strategy.
* Support resource planning, organizational design, and workforce optimization initiatives to ensure appropriate staffing and scalability.
* Ensure risks, dependencies, priorities, and business outcomes are appropriately managed across strategic initiatives and change portfolios.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, client focus, and continuous improvement across global teams.

**Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of investment operations, investment performance, analytics, compliance, risk reporting and client servicing environments.

* Ability to influence and build partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Client Service and other key stakeholder organizations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change.

Robert Walters is the world’s most trusted talent solutions business. Across the globe, we deliver recruitment, outsourcing, and talent advisory services for businesses of all sizes, opening doors for people with diverse skills, ambitions, and backgrounds.

Our client is seeking a
**Head, Credit Risk Review, Specialised Finance**
in the
**Banking**
division.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a global team, providing top-tier service to existing and prospective clients while expanding the business on a product and global level.

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary:**

* Lead independent, technical, and forward-looking assessments of the credit quality, risk governance, and control environment across the Group's global Specialized Finance portfolio.
* Exercise independent challenge and escalation authority under the Credit Risk Review mandate while maintaining clear separation from first-line credit and business decision-making.
* Conduct independent reviews that drive strategic and business outcomes, including decisions on portfolio growth, risk appetite, sector and country concentrations, capital deployment, hold levels, and distribution strategy.
* Identify emerging and systemic risks, influence improvements in underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management, and ensure timely remediation of material weaknesses.
* Provide senior management, risk committees, and regulators with independent assurance on underwriting, structuring, portfolio quality, risk appetite alignment, lifecycle monitoring, and problem-credit management.
* Perform Business Credit Application and portfolio reviews across Project Finance, Sponsor Finance, Private Credit, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Infrastructure & Power, Natural Resources, Transportation (Shipping/Aviation), Export Finance, Structured Asset Finance, and other asset-backed or cash-flow-based lending.
* Focus on Credit Risk and its interaction with ESG, climate, and country risks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategy
:**

Maintain awareness of the Group's Specialized Finance strategy and assess whether growth priorities, sector and country concentrations, tenor, leverage, distribution assumptions and originate-to-distribute activity remain aligned with approved risk appetite. Specifically the role requires:

* Served as the senior independent reviewer for Specialized Finance, providing oversight and escalation of key credit and portfolio risks.
* Advised leadership on portfolio strategy, risk appetite, growth priorities, capital deployment, and concentration limits.
* Identified emerging and systemic risks across sectors and regions, recommending risk mitigation and control enhancements.
* Assessed portfolio sustainability under stressed conditions, balancing risk, return, capital, and concentration exposures.
* Independently challenged underwriting, portfolio management, and strategic decisions to ensure compliance with approved risk appetite.
* Monitored portfolio vulnerabilities and concentrations, ensuring timely identification and remediation of material risks.

**Business**
:

* Provided strategic oversight of Specialized Finance portfolios, aligning growth, capital allocation, sustainability objectives, and distribution strategies with risk appetite.
* Assessed macroeconomic, sector, sovereign, commodity, and market risks impacting portfolio performance and resilience.
* Evaluated portfolio exposures to concentration, refinancing, interest rate, inflation, and other emerging risk factors through forward-looking reviews.
* Led independent assessment of complex project and structured finance transactions, including cash flow analysis, ESG/climate risks, and distressed assets.
* Translated portfolio and thematic review findings into strategic recommendations to enhance underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management practices.
* Influenced senior stakeholders to strengthen credit governance, risk controls, risk appetite adherence, and portfolio resilience through effective challenge and remediation oversight.

**Processes**
:

* Led Specialized Finance credit reviews, ensuring compliance with policies, regulations, and governance standards.
* Enhanced review methodologies, portfolio analytics, and risk assessment frameworks.
* Conducted end-to-end credit reviews, including transaction assessment, model validation, and stakeholder engagement.
* Developed risk-based review programs covering high-risk sectors, jurisdictions, refinancing risks, and portfolio concentrations.
* Evaluated complex financing structures and key legal, ESG, technical, valuation, and financial risks.
* Identified and escalated material underwriting, monitoring, concentration, and control weaknesses, driving timely remediation.

**Risk Management:**

* Conducted end-to-end reviews of Specialized Finance transactions, assessing sponsor strength, project viability, leverage, cash flows, covenants, and refinancing risk.
* Performed stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate repayment capacity, credit quality, and recovery outcomes.
* Reviewed funding structures, covenant compliance, drawdown controls, reserve adequacy, and sponsor support arrangements.
* Assessed risk ratings, expected loss, collateral valuations, and recovery assumptions for accuracy and appropriateness.
* Evaluated distressed credits, restructuring strategies, refinancing options, and recovery plans.
* Identified, challenged, and escalated material credit and structural risks, driving effective risk mitigation and remediation.

**Governance**
:

* Assess the effectiveness of global, regional and country governance for Specialized Finance, including sector oversight, delegated authorities, credit committee challenge, exception governance, portfolio limits, concentration monitoring, model governance and watchlist escalation.
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Deliver effective governance through credible challenge of senior executives on complex Specialized Finance judgements and maintain open, cooperative engagement with relevant regulators.

**Regulatory and Business Conduct:**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Valued Behaviours and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; and The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identiW, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

MUSO Enterprise Risk is seeking a Vice President to lead the Historical Market Data (HMD) function in Pune. HMD manages the market time-series data used to calculate Value at Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR) and other key market risk measures.

The VP of HMD, Pune will lead and develop the local team, own delivery of data onboarding and quality commitments, and work closely with the Mizuho Americas HMD team as one integrated global function. * Escalate delivery risks, dependencies and control issues promptly.
* Establish clear hand-offs, escalation paths, priorities and shared delivery plans across time zones.

Historical Market Data Management

* Identify data and technology issues and drive sustainable solutions through implementation.
* Ensure changes are tested, documented and implemented with appropriate controls.

* Support audit, regulatory and control requirements for market data used in risk measures.
* Build capability in Pune and promote knowledge sharing across the global HMD function.

Requirements:

* Master’s degree in Statistics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in financial services, market data, risk data or data analysis.

jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Role Overview:**

Mizuho America’s Model Risk Management is the firm’s second line of defense and is responsible for managing model risk generated via the firm’s various entities and corporate functions. The group is tasked with establishing and implementing an SR 26-2 consistent risk management framework by which the firm’s model inventory is effectively challenged and validated. The group is also tasked with managing model risk governance, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. Mizuho seeks a highly motivated individual to serve as a Director, responsible for building and leading Model Risk team at the Mizuho Pune office. The role reports locally to the Mizuho Pune Head of Risk and globally to the Head of Model Risk Management within America’s Risk Management department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Establish and lead the Model Risk capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
* Build and lead a high-performing Pune Model Risk team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk-management hub.
* Act as the senior Model Risk point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global Model Risk teams.
* Manage a team of validation specialists, focusing on Pricing/Valuation models for Equity and Fixed Income Derivatives, XVA and other related models, providing guidance as necessary to ensure that the most robust independent review and challenge is possible
* Train and develop junior team members focusing on overlapping areas of expertise within the team, independence of view, and vocal challenge
* Design, build, and manage Model Risk workflow management, including AI tools, to assist in the efficient execution of the group's framework.
* Assist in maintaining a strong model governance framework, working with management and model owners to ensure maximum alignment with regulatory and policy requirements

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience Qualifications:**

* 18-20+ years of experience in financial services with specific experience in Model Risk
* Solid understanding of risk management concepts
* Working knowledge of SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance on model risk management
* Strong management skills with experience in managing quants while maintaining strong relationships with management and business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience in responding to audit and regulatory requests
* Impeccable attention to detail and a high standard of polish with regards to documentation and presentation materials

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

jobs.description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Business Head?**

As a Business Head at SmartQ you will be spearheading the development of new business, setting the course for other business verticals to follow, executing high-level business strategies, and championing the pursuit of organizational excellence. Your expertise will be crucial in defining and realizing our global aspirations, driving sustainable growth, and ensuring our position as a leader in the industry.

We are looking for a dynamic professional with strong operational expertise and proven leadership

experience who can make a meaningful impact on our expanding business presence. If you are eager to contribute to the evolving world of food and technology and possess the skills to lead with excellence, we would be delighted to have you join our team.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive business strategies aligned with the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth plans within the F&B industry.
* Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer preferences, and new business opportunities, enabling the organization to maintain a strong competitive advantage.
* Manage end-to-end operations of the F&B business unit, ensuring seamless coordination across departments and delivering operational excellence.
* Streamline operational processes and implement efficiency-driven initiatives to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and reduce operational costs.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management to achieve revenue growth, profitability, and financial sustainability targets.
* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams by fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning to ensure individual and organizational success.
* Promote a positive and customer-focused workplace culture that encourage teamwork, innovation, and superior service delivery.
* Identify and pursue new business expansion opportunities across existing and untapped markets while collaborating with sales and marketing teams to strengthen business development and accelerate revenue generation.
* Monitor key business metrics, operational KPIs, and financial performance to ensure continuous improvement and achievement of organizational goals.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, quality standards, food safety protocols, and company policies across all business operations

**Qualifications:**

* Proven 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in the food services or F&B industry, with a strong track record of driving business growth, operational excellence, and profitability in high-performance environments.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Hospitality, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale business operations, managing cross-functional teams, and delivering strategic initiatives in a senior leadership capacity.
* Exceptional strategic thinking, business acumen, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions in fast-paced and dynamic environments.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, partners, and senior management effectively.
* Sound financial expertise with proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, cost optimization, and revenue enhancement strategies.
* Deep understanding of the food services industry, market trends, customer behavior, operational best practices, and competitive business landscapes.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who we are**
With over $1.58 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Your Team**
Team of circa 40 individuals, dedicated to supporting Private Market Operations globally. The team covers a very wide range of activities, from UW and performance measurement to Investors reporting, including data governance and management.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead and manage multiple teams within our Private Market Operations function in Hyderabad (Performance, Research, Operations, Marketing, UW, etc).
