jobs.title: Investor Services Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Job Description**
As Investor Services India Lead you lead Investor Services in India. You build the team, bring each specialist team live with the right controls in place, and run India to our global service levels as part of one team across India, Europe, Asia and the US.
  
  
You are the senior Investor Services voice in India and a partner to Investor Services leaders in other locations, Compliance and our transformation programme.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Leading Investor Services India**

* Own performance of every India specialist team against our service levels, quality measures and capacity targets, and report monthly.
* Plan capacity and growth with the Regional Head and partner hubs, including cover when other hubs are stretched.

**Building and launching**

* Recruit, onboard and assess the India team.
* Bring each specialist team live once the systems, routing and reporting it needs are in place.
* Run interim arrangements and parallel running until then; nothing is switched off before its replacement works.

**Controls and risk**

* Run India to a high-risk control standard: separation of duties, independent quality checks in another hub, documented sign-off and a complete audit trail.
* Own business continuity for India: take over live cases within 24 hours when needed, and test it twice a year.
* Lead India's part in audits and regulatory reviews, and close findings on time.

**Working as one global team**

* Run handovers with hubs in Europe and Asia so cases keep moving around the clock.
* Route work between hubs so every team member can build the experience they need.
* Make sure escalations follow the right compliance route for each country.

**People and culture**

* Lead the India team and build a culture of quality, ownership and growth.
* Own engagement, retention and succession for Investor Services India.

**Transformation**

* Represent India in the design of our end-to-end KYC process, the Fenergo roadmap and the wider Investor Services programme.
* Drive improvements that remove manual handoffs and shorten the time investors wait.

**How You Grow**
Our people build their careers by moving through ten KYC specialisms every 6–12 months, each ending with a skills assessment and a certification. Progression is by competency, not tenure, and experienced hires are assessed on joining and start at the level they have earned.
  
  
The role is a platform for wider regional or global Investor Services leadership.
  
  
**What You Bring**
Your CV needs to show at least 10 years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5 or more years leading multi-team operations; applications without this won't be taken forward.
  
  

* 10+ years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5+ years leading multi-team operations in financial services.
* Experience building and scaling a team in India for global stakeholders.
* A strong control mindset: audits, regulatory reviews and operational risk.
* Data-driven management of service levels, quality and capacity.
* Excellent senior stakeholder management across Europe, Asia and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Fund administration, transfer agency or private markets experience.
* Experience of technology-led operations change, ideally with Fenergo.
* ACAMS, ICA diploma or equivalent.
* Experience of a global capability centre or round-the-clock operating model.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
  
  
(Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy-notice/)

jobs.description:

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

This position functions as regional general counsel for all CIBC India business activities, principally supporting CIBC India as a global delivery centre servicing CIBC legal entities and business units globally. The overall purpose of the role is to provide leadership and advice regarding legal matters, with the objective of helping business leaders achieve business goals in a manner consistent with sound risk management. The Head of Legal, India negotiates agreements, manages litigation, and participates as the Legal representative on applicable regional governance committees.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**Value Added Partner:**

* Provide legal advice in relation to business plans and help to ensure proper implementation of those plans, consistent with legal and any applicable regulatory requirements.

* Active member of CIBC India regional senior management team and any related committees.
* Fulfill commitments embodied in the Legal Department mandate in relation to CIBC India.



**Transaction and Litigation Support:**

* Provide legal advice and related governance to support CIBC India’s business activities, including with respect to CIBC India’s employment law and intellectual property matters and regulatory changes.
* Negotiate CIBC's agreements India, either directly or through external counsel acting under your oversight.
* Manage CIBC's litigation in India and keep global Legal team and regional senior management apprised of significant developments and deadlines. Often such litigation involves complex cross border Issues requiring coordination and management among internal business and infrastructure groups, law firms, witnesses and courts in different jurisdictions and time zones.

**Internal and External Business Development/Client Service:**

* Monitor legal changes in the relevant jurisdictions to assess the impact on relevant lines of business, and identify new business opportunities and/or regulatory risks.

**Risk Management:**

* Identify legal risks, and significant incidents of non-compliance, and escalate these to global Legal team and senior management of India (as relevant), ensuring such risks are properly understood. Where possible, propose appropriate risk mitigation.
* Conduct quarterly Board Meetings in India (in person or virtually from India) and any ad hoc or additional Board meetings as necessary.
* Prepare and maintain statutory registers, minutes, resolutions, notices, and agendas.
* Support information requests relating to Legal’s accountabilities from internal and external auditors.
* Ensure compliance with up to 325 event-based activities and ~66 regular compliance requirements under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Advise on legal matters pertaining to corporate governance, corporate actions, drafting, and regulatory filings.
* Liaise with regulatory bodies and ensure effective communication and resolution of statutory matters.

**Governance and Reporting:**

* Prepare and present Legal reporting to senior management and Board in India and Legal global management.
* Partner with Legal’s Transformation & Operational Resilience team (as the 1B function for Legal) to complete attestation and certification of controls and deficiencies.

**Continuous Learning and Professional Development:**

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry trends relating to CIBC India’s business activities.

**Experience: 15+ years:**

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

* University degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Law, or related field (MBA, M.Com, LLB, B.Com), with a degree in law and admission to practice as an Advocate preferred.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in secretarial, legal, and corporate governance.
* Extensive knowledge of Companies Act, 2013, corporate governance, and statutory compliance.
* Strong understanding of Indian legal and regulatory requirements applicable to a global capability centre, in particular relating to employment law and intellectual property.
* Previous experience in a global delivery centre or a large international organization preferred.

**Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non-Deposit accepting Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.
  
  
ABCL offers end-to-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers - Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid & Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health & Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.
  
  
ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.
  
  
**Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.
  
  
**Job Context**

**Key Challenges**

* Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction-to-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores >90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

**Yield & Profitability Management**

**Compliance, Audit & Governance**

* Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.

**Customer Service & Branch Experience**

* Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.

**People Leadership & Productivity**

* Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on-the-job training, and reviews.

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

jobs.description:
**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

Department: GO - GCC Bengaluru

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.
* Trusted adviser: build senior relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, and position the bank beyond its traditional financing role as an adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and strategy.
* M&A execution: lead sell-side and buy-side transactions end to end. This covers transaction strategy, valuation, process design, marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and closing.
* Equity story and positioning: develop compelling equity and investment narratives for clients and assets, combining rigorous financial analysis with a clear view of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation.
* Buyer and investor access: identify, approach and build credibility with strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors, both in the region and internationally.
* Private capital: originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. **Director, Treasury Program Management**

**Shift Timing : 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM**

**Location- India – Bangalore**

**Job Summary**

- We are seeking a Director, Treasury Program Management, to lead large treasury programs across the global organization.

- This role drives execution across treasury systems, bank connectivity, payments modernization, settlement workflows, controls, reporting, exception-based processing, automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and process improvement.

- The Director will lead programs across payments, capital markets, middle office workflows, credit facility administration, loan seasoning, investing, management reporting, and forecasting.

**What You’ll Do**

Program Delivery & Governance

- Lead treasury programs end-to-end: Manage planning, execution, implementation, adoption, and post-go-live stabilization while overseeing milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and issue management.

- Own program delivery & governance: Maintain program plans, stakeholder updates, and reporting while translating business objectives into workstreams, requirements, testing plans, controls, and implementation roadmaps.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders: Partner with Treasury, Capital Markets, Middle Office, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Technology, banks, vendors, and service providers.

- Drive automation & exception-based processing: Reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and expand automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and operational transparency.

- Improve payments, settlements & bank connectivity: Enhance payment initiation, approval workflows, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and bank connectivity including SWIFT and ISO 20022.

- Standardize treasury payment workflows: Streamline processes across regions, funds, entities, currencies, and banking partners while reducing breaks and manual intervention.

**What You’ll Bring**

Required Experience

**- 15+ years of experience in treasury, treasury operations, middle office, capital markets operations, finance transformation, program management, or related financial services roles.**

**- Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple stakeholders.**

**- Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls, reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.**

**- Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation, and change management.**

**Must-Have Technical / Tools Criteria**

**- Must-have technical skills for this role include reporting, visualization, workflow, automation, and testing capabilities across the treasury ecosystem, including automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, SWIFT payment format testing automation, and treasury platform testing automation.**

**- Hands-on experience using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL, Python, workflow tools, test automation frameworks, or low-code automation platforms to support treasury process improvement, reporting, and automation, with examples including Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, KNIME, dbt, Apache Airflow, pytest, Robot Framework, and Selenium-based testing approaches.**

- Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis, issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

**- Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based processing.**

- Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports, process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

**- Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank-specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury payment workflows.**

- Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls, interfaces, and related system integrations.

- Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test evidence management, and implementation readiness.

**- Ability to partner effectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations stakeholders without being a pure technology role.**

- Exposure to AI-enabled automation or agentic workflow capabilities in treasury, finance, or operations is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech, treasury operations, or global capability centers.**

**- Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals, ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.**

**- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement processes, and treasury controls.**

**- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.**

**- CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.**

**create customer delight**
,

.

* Advanced analytical expertise with hands-on exposure to AI/ML deployment in healthcare RCM.
* Experience with specialized healthcare API integrations and modern cloud data architectures.

  We encourage you to experiment, challenge the status quo, and bring cutting-edge AI and automation ideas to life.

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce India Professional Services partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.
  
  
**The Experience:**

As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior leader and a foremost expert in delivering business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully billable, high-impact role. You will be the Delivery Leader on strategic and complex customer engagements, and you will own the health, margin and outcomes of a multi-program portfolio.

You bring an India Financial Services background. You have delivered projects for banks, NBFCs, insurers and other FS clients, and you understand the domain and its regulatory context.

You are the strategic advisor and the point of accountability. You will drive platform adoption, demonstrate ROI, mitigate revenue and license attrition risk, and deliver agentic and generative AI programs on time, within budget and with quantifiable outcomes. You see risk before it lands and leave the portfolio and the team stronger than you found them. Keeping a project green is not enough.

  
  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**

Run the portfolio on live data, not static RAG status: margin variance, revenue, pipeline, billing milestones, bookings and delivered margin. Flag margin erosion and scope creep early.

Make sure staffing, DSR and SWE processes are followed, not just reminded. Keep delivery review canvases and status artifacts complete and current, without being chased.
* Cross-functional influence and expertise: Guide customer, partner (SI) and internal teams (MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs). Be a deep expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, custom development, integration and data migration.
  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience and domain: You have 15+ years in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large, complex SaaS/CRM implementations. You have an India Financial Services background (banking, NBFC/lending, insurance or wealth), have delivered projects there, and know FS processes, regulation and customer landscapes.
* Technical grounding: Some technical hands-on background is preferred, from development, solution architecture or technical lead roles. It lets you challenge estimates and designs and earn credibility with architects and developers.
* Platform expertise: You know Salesforce implementation patterns, integration, custom development and data migration. You understand Agentforce use cases and Data Cloud dependencies.
* Commercial and financial command: You are comfortable with PSA financials (margin, EVA, billing, forecast, utilization). You can explain a margin movement and act on it.
* Executive presence: You communicate exceptionally well, build C-level relationships, handle difficult conversations and negotiate high-stakes outcomes. You have recovered strategic accounts and driven adoption in at-risk environments.
* Ownership: You surface risks and gaps yourself and don't wait for reminders or escalations.
* People leadership: You have led pre-sales and delivery teams across geographies and cultures. You support learning, career growth, well-being, and diversity and inclusion. You coach people toward becoming well-rounded leaders and manage a workable span of control.

As a self-starter, you will lead consultants and influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization. From a management perspective, you will champion an AI-First engineering methodology while tracking program health, team velocity, and overall efficiency.
  

  

**Education and certifications:**

**Job Summary**

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**

This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. **What you'll do**

* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

* **Scope and direction:** Owns the Lending engineering domain and acts independently to set direction and allocate people, budget and capacity across programmes, projects and services.
* **Problem solving and standards:** Resolves complex technical, operational and organizational problems, and recommends standards and operating strategies that mitigate risk and drive growth.
* **Planning and execution:** Develops and executes plans to achieve key Lending business objectives in collaboration with senior management.
* **Influence:** Fosters collaboration across the business, influences more senior colleagues and presents to the management chain up to the ELT when required.
* **Innovation:** Brings forward new ideas, notably in agentic AI engineering, that benefit Universal Banking and Finastra as a whole.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Engineering Strategy and Agentic AI Transformation***

* Define and own the Lending engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with product strategy, architecture and business outcomes, including modernization on Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices.
* Lead the shift to an agentic AI-first engineering model in which AI agents and engineers work together across the full lifecycle, with clear adoption targets and measurable gains in productivity, quality and cycle time.
* Make and own decisions on resource allocation, investment, tooling and build, buy or partner options, and influence platform and architecture decisions across the CTO organization.

***AI-Enabled End-to-End Software Delivery***

* **Plan:** Use AI agents with Product to refine requirements, generate user stories and acceptance criteria, and improve estimation and backlog prioritization.
* **Design and build:** Apply AI-assisted design reviews, agentic code generation, refactoring, legacy modernization and code review using tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* **Test and secure:** Drive AI-generated test cases, test data and automated regression, with AI-assisted security and vulnerability scanning built into CI/CD (shift-left quality and DevSecOps).
* **Release and deploy:** Own CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, versioning, change approvals and deployment orchestration, including containerized deployments to Kubernetes across cloud and on-premises environments, with a high degree of automation.
* **Document and enable:** Use AI to keep technical documentation, release notes and knowledge bases current for Services, Support and implementation partners.

***SDLC/PMLC and AI Governance***

* Own the SDLC and PMLC for Lending, ensuring rigour, transparency and measurability, in alignment with the Enterprise PMO, Product Strategy and Architecture.
* Establish guardrails for the responsible use of AI agents, including human-in-the-loop review, model and prompt governance, data classification, IP and security controls, and auditability, in line with Finastra policies and regulatory requirements.
* Track delivery, quality and AI-adoption metrics (for example, DORA metrics, defect leakage and AI acceptance rates) and act on trends.

***Operations, Reliability and Service Management***

* Participate and provide product support for Production incident triage, root-cause analysis and problem management, using AIOps and AI-assisted diagnostics to reduce MTTR and recurring issues.
* Contribute to change, release, configuration and environment management, and oversee performance, scalability and capacity planning across environments.
* Partner with SRE/Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet agreed SLAs and SLOs.

***People Leadership and Stakeholder Influence***

* Lead, coach and develop squad leads and senior technical staff, building succession and AI-ready engineering skills across the organization.
* Own organization design, workforce planning, hiring and performance management within budget, and lead teams through change, including the transition to new ownership.
* Partner daily with Product, GTM, Services and shared services, act as the technical voice of Lending with customers, and present to senior leadership up to the ELT.

**Competencies / Experience:14+Years**

  

***Essential***

* Track record of leading engineering tribes or domains of 20+ smart engineers across multiple squads, managing through squad leads.
* Proven leadership of application engineering and strategy for enterprise-grade, B2B, mission-critical solutions. A background in fintech and financial services is required; lending experience is preferred.
* Strong exposure to Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices, with hands-on experience of container-based deployment using Docker and Kubernetes (or managed services such as AKS, EKS or OpenShift), Helm and GitOps-driven release pipelines.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and leading agentic AI adoption across the SDLC, with demonstrable productivity and quality outcomes.
* Has led Agile engineering transformation, with a strong understanding of SAFe and, preferably, LeSS or the Spotify model. Well versed in DevOps/DevSecOps and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Mature leader with strong communication, strategic thinking, complex problem solving and senior stakeholder

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

* Work closely with individual business and functional leaders to identify opportunities to embed AI into existing processes, products and services.

* Build strong relationships across the organisation, acting as a trusted AI advisor to senior executives and functional leaders.
* Lead discussions and workshops with business leaders to identify opportunities, address challenges and accelerate AI adoption.

* A clearly defined and actionable corporate AI strategy.
* Strong alignment and engagement from the CEO and senior leadership team.
* AI opportunities identified and embedded across key business functions.

**Experience**

* Experience engaging senior stakeholders, managing governance forums, resolving cross-functional issues and influencing decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Experience building or leading small expert teams, setting delivery standards and developing capability in transformation, process excellence or service improvement.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Deep knowledge of Source-to-Pay process design, controls, policy alignment, service management and continuous improvement.
* Ability to convert data, VOC feedback and operational pain points into prioritised transformation opportunities with clear value cases.

Edison Smart is exclusively supporting a leading banking group in the UAE with the appointment of a Senior Manager to establish the institutions AI change and adoption programmes.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Group Digital & AI function and play a pivotal role in one of the organisation's most important strategic transformation initiatives.

The organisation is making significant investments in Enterprise AI and Generative AI capabilities and is looking for an experienced banking transformation leader to ensure these technologies are successfully adopted, embedded and utilised across the business.

This is not a traditional Change Management position. The successful individual will take ownership of the bank-wide AI Champions and Change programme, building the structures, communities and engagement strategies required to make AI adoption successful at enterprise scale.

**IMPORTANT: This is an international relocation-only opportunity based in UAE. Candidates must be currently based outside the UAE and genuinely willing to relocate.**

The Role

Reporting into the Group Digital & AI function, you will lead the strategy and execution of the organisation's enterprise AI change and adoption programme.

You will work closely with AI Product Owners, senior business stakeholders, HR, Learning & Development and Internal Communications to ensure AI capabilities translate into meaningful changes in how employees work.

Key responsibilities will include:

* **AI Champions Network:**
  Design, establish and lead a bank-wide AI Champions network, developing the operating model, selection criteria, engagement strategy and governance required to drive adoption across multiple business units.
* **Enterprise AI Adoption:**
  Own the change and adoption strategy for enterprise AI and CRM platforms, ensuring successful integration into everyday business operations.
* **Change Strategy:**
  Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies, assessing organisational readiness, people impacts and potential barriers to adoption.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Build strong relationships with senior business leaders, securing executive sponsorship and accountability for AI adoption outcomes.
* **Employee Enablement:**
  Partner with Learning & Development to develop AI training programmes, role-based learning pathways, prompt libraries and practical enablement resources.
* **AI Engagement & Communications:**
  Lead internal engagement campaigns, champion forums and communications that build confidence and enthusiasm around AI.
* **Adoption Measurement:**
  Monitor employee engagement, adoption levels and proficiency, identifying areas requiring additional intervention and support.
* **Responsible AI:**
  Ensure AI adoption is aligned with organisational policies, data privacy requirements and responsible AI principles.
* **Product Collaboration:**
  Work closely with AI Product Owners to capture employee feedback and influence future product enhancements.

You will also lead a dedicated team within the Champions & Change function and play an important role in developing the wider enterprise AI adoption operating model.

The Candidate We Want

We are looking for an established change and transformation leader with direct experience within the banking and financial services sector.

**Direct banking experience is essential.**
We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked within leading international banks, ideally within a centralised AI Centre of Excellence (CoE), Chief Data & AI Office, Group Digital & AI function or similar enterprise transformation environment.

The strongest candidates will have been directly involved in establishing, scaling or leading AI adoption programmes within a large banking organisation.

We are particularly interested in people who have:

* Led enterprise-wide AI adoption or Generative AI transformation programmes within a bank.
* Established or scaled AI Champions networks, communities of practice or internal AI ambassador programmes.
* Driven the adoption of AI tools across large, complex and highly regulated organisations.
* Built AI literacy, employee enablement and workforce capability programmes.
* Worked closely with senior leadership, business executives and technology teams.
* Developed change management strategies covering multiple business units and employee populations.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise AI platforms and CRM technologies.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI adoption within regulated financial services environments.

Essential Requirements

* Minimum 7 years' experience in Change Management, Technology Adoption or Organisational Transformation.
* Minimum 4 years' direct experience within banking or financial services.
* A demonstrable track record of enterprise technology adoption, ideally with a strong focus on AI and Generative AI.
* Experience establishing and managing AI adoption programmes, communities or champion networks.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Psychology or a related discipline.
* Professional Change Management certification, ideally Prosci or APMG.
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement, communication and leadership capabilities.
* Experience within a central AI CoE, Chief Data & AI Office or enterprise AI transformation function would be particularly attractive.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take on a strategically important leadership position at a time when AI is fundamentally changing the banking industry.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape how AI is adopted across an entire banking organisation.
* Build and lead an enterprise-wide AI Champions network.
* Work alongside senior AI leadership and enterprise product teams.
* Influence the organisation's long-term AI transformation strategy.
* Establish yourself within one of the Middle East's most ambitious digital and AI environments.

International Relocation – UAE

This position is based in the UAE and is open exclusively to candidates relocating internationally.

For the right individual, this represents an opportunity to take a significant career step while relocating to one of the world's fastest-growing financial and technology hubs.

The UAE offers an established international banking sector, excellent global connectivity and an attractive lifestyle for internationally experienced professionals and their families.

Relocation and employment package details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Interested?

If you have directly led AI adoption within a major banking organisation and are interested in relocating to the UAE, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

**Apply directly through Edison Smart or contact our team to discuss the opportunity.**

Edison Smart – Connecting exceptional talent with the future of technology.

**GCC Sales Leader**

.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Partner
jobs.description:
**Title:**
Client Solutions Partner, Applied AI

**Experience:**
7–15 years

**Location:**
Mumbai / Bangalore

Be the single point of contact for Quantiphi's Applied AI offering across an assigned portfolio of accounts. You turn each client's business challenges into defined, sellable Applied AI solutions and prove they can be built. You grow offering-attached bookings in those accounts by leading a team of Sales Engineers from discovery through technical sign-off.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Whitespace discovery and problem definition**

* Map Applied AI whitespace across each account's technology and business landscape with the Client Partner and Direct Sales, converting gaps into qualified offering-attached pipeline.
* Lead solution advisory workshops with customers, positioning Applied AI offerings before formal RFPs are issued.
* Convert business priorities into clearly defined technical problems with agreed scope, success criteria and constraints, so technology and business sponsors share one definition of the problem.
* Frame a roadmap for each account, from initial AI workloads (Agent Platform, GenAI, Agentic AI, ML/predictive, computer vision) to enterprise-wide adoption.

**Solution blueprinting and pursuits**

* Own the solution blueprint for Applied AI pursuits in the portfolio, covering: Reference architecture, Stack trade-offs, Technical risk assessment, A business case quantifying return, operational impact and risk.
* Direct technical RFP responses: solution narrative, architecture and data-pipeline design, effort estimates and BOM.
* Lead pitches tailored to each audience to secure technical sign-off: feasibility for technical evaluators, outcomes and ROI for business sponsors.

**PoCs and demonstrations**

* Define scope, success criteria and milestones for pre-sales PoCs and pilots where evidence strengthens the case.
* Present PoC results (accuracy, latency, business outcomes) to executive buyers, and convert successful PoCs into production SOWs.

**Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and allocate the Sales Engineers across portfolio pursuits.
* Review all blueprints, demos and RFP content before they reach the client.
* Run the weekly workload pipeline and pursuit review for the portfolio.

**Required Skills:**

* 7–15 years in technology services or enterprise software, including significant time in a senior customer-facing solutioning role.
* Hands-on depth in GenAI (RAG, agents, LLMs) plus ML/predictive or computer vision.
* Production-grade cloud architecture experience for AI systems.
* Ability to build business cases and ROI models that business sponsors and finance stakeholders accept.
* A record of winning technical evaluations and RFPs in enterprise deals.
* Credibility with both engineers and CXOs, explaining complex architectures in plain business terms.
* Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team.

**Preferred**

* Strong Cloud or Frontier Lab experience
* Professional cloud or AI certifications.
* Domain exposure in Manufacturing, Automotive, Transportation, or Logistics industries
* Practical grounding in responsible AI, AI evaluation and LLMOps/MLOps.

jobs.description:
**About Vivriti Group:**

Vivriti Next is the holding entity of the Vivriti Group, comprising Vivriti Capital, a fintech NBFC, and Vivriti Asset Management, an asset manager of fixed-income AIF schemes.

We empower mid-market enterprises with high-end advisory, research-driven insights, and opportunities to scale through tech-enabled solutions, while solving complex challenges beyond financing.

**About Vivriti Asset Management:**

Vivriti Asset Management is a subsidiary of Vivriti Next and is an investment manager to fixed income alternate investment funds (AIFs). As on date, Vivriti AMC has raised commitments of over INR 8,000 crores from 1700+ institutional, HNIs, FOs investors. AMC has also made investments of over INR 11,000 across 110+ entities and has launched multiple category-creating, highly differentiated AIF funds which provide an investor with options across the tenor, rating and return spectrum (10% to 17%). Our investors span marquee domestic banks, insurance companies, DFIs, corporate treasuries, family offices & offshore investors.

***Designation: Regional Head, South – Institutional Sales***

Vivriti AMC in the current fiscal (FY 26-27) is raising capital in 3 private credit funds with a target to raise approx. 3000 crores this fiscal.

Key Responsibilities

* **Core Role and Geography:**
  Lead capital raising initiatives for AIFs targeting various class of investors across South India Region.
* **Capital Formation & Fundraising:**
  Act as a strategic bridge between the organization and institutional clients, driving capital raising and relationship management.
* **Manage Strategic Relationships:**
  Acquire, develop, and enhance relationships with Institutional Clients, Family Offices, Insurance Companies, Banks, Corporate Treasuries, and any other evolving non-individual segments.
* **Lead Product Positioning:**
  Work closely with investment teams to articulate compelling investment propositions and tailor solutions to investor needs.

jobs.title: Client Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.
