jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.

**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. **Sales Director / Manager – Africa**
is responsible for driving

across the region. The role owns the

, including pipeline development, strategic account management, complex deal structuring, and executive‑level stakeholder engagement, while working closely with

to ensure sustainable growth and customer success

* Own and deliver regional sales targets, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.
* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

**Job Description**
**About Us**
Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.
  
  
We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.
  
  

**If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.**

**About Wealth and Retail Banking**
Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.
  
  
**About the Job**
To become a strategic professional within our team, while utilizing your experience in building and managing client relationships, across the region. Your focus will be on developing new relationships, to onboard new clients while maintaining and servicing a portfolio, through excellent communication, negotiation and customer service.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Creation of strategic plans for revenue generation and business development while driving the Digital Agenda.
* Generate new business to achieve defined targets in terms of the number of customers, volumes and revenue, including product mix, active/ passive ratio, liability targetsAbo, transactions.
* Induction of all (NTB) new customers brought in by the Branches & Direct Sales team.
* Creation of sales call plans to acquire large prospective customers through referrals.
* Update & maintain all Sales MIS (Calls, Prospects, Attritions, Business done, etc.)
* Effectively meeting customer expectations and handling/ reduction of customer complaints while providing professional customer service to achieve a high percentage of customer satisfaction and retention.
* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations for your team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure KYC/AML updates, proper zero error documentation.
* To be able to detect any suspicious transactions, Money laundering, forgeries etc.
* Highest compliance with reference to Anti Bribery, Anti Money Laundering & Combating Financial Crime Risk procedures.
* Obtain Security & Commodity Authority (SCA) license (within 6 months of joining) and timely completion of Continuous Program Development (CPD) requirement post SCA licensing. This is a mandatory requirement for the role.

Our Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Experienced Sales and Relationship Manager with background in handling all Banking & Investment Products. Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes.
* Networking ability to manage interdepartmental deliverables.
* Strong inter-personal skills and leadership ability, which encourages and promotes enthusiasm and team spirit.
* Good understanding of the business environment in UAE preferably with direct contacts with the local HNI community.
* Adapting to multi-cultural environment.
* In-depth knowledge of capital markets and financial planning
* SCA certified (or completion of certificate within 6 months)

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* **Do the right thing**
  and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,**
  continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together,**
  we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What we offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,**
  with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time-off**
  including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working**
  options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support**
  through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture**
  to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,**
  one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**Profile Description**
Standard Chartered Bank

jobs.title: Principal Process Architect - Core Finance Systems
jobs.description:
**Overview**
Intuit's mission is powering prosperity around the world. We do this by attracting the world's top talent, delivering innovative solutions for consumers, small businesses, self-employed professionals, and accounting experts. Every day we innovate with our flagship products: TurboTax, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Credit Karma. For over 100 million customers, we deliver more money, more time, and more confidence.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
We are seeking a Principal Process Architect to spearhead end-to-end process design and implementation across Core Finance, encompassing plan-to-perform and underlying financial operations. Operating as a senior individual contributor, you will collaborate with key technology and finance leaders to turn strategic goals into actionable outcomes—simplifying complex workflows, re-architecting processes, driving full-scale automation, and enabling real-time analytics. In this role, you will hold complete accountability for key transformation workstreams, managing every phase from target-state workflow design and data alignment to requirements definition, implementation, and organizational adoption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Process Architecture: Influence and shape the transformation roadmap by providing process architecture expertise that aligns with core finance priorities, supporting a cohesive enterprise-wide operational strategy. Codify the delivery model into reusable playbooks so it can be replicated across the Finance teams and new initiatives.
* Program & Sprint-Based Execution: Drive cross-functional execution of a program from discovery through delivery, ensuring it is delivered on time, to a high standard of quality, within budget, and in accordance with stated business and technical objectives.
* Discovery & Prioritization: Lead structured discovery through the use of a process intelligence tools and stakeholder sessions and workshops to quantify when process time is spent and the current state landscape. Translate observed friction into prioritized opportunity pipeline across levers such as automating manual work, fixing the data model, changing the operating model (process), or solve through system changes/enhancements .
* Operational Excellence & Innovation: Streamline ambiguous & inefficient processes within the core finance function. Focus on accelerating and optimizing operations by replacing manual tasks with automated capabilities or process improvements. Design AI-enabled solutions and processes hands-on through prototype, test, and refine cycle, separating what AI can solve from what requires data remodel or engineering.
* Solution Design & Development: Collaborate with IT and finance business stakeholders to design scalable financial solutions and automations. Ensure that new capabilities are innovative, repeatable, and aligned with organizational growth.
* Data Reconciliation & Automation: Structure and reconcile high-volume transaction data across disparate systems, identify root causes of discrepancies, and architect automated, controlled workflows for detection and resolution on packaged ERP/SaaS and custom finance applications.
* Stakeholder Influence & Decision Support: Act as a trusted advisor to finance leadership, using data and analysis to inform prioritization and decision-making; influence senior stakeholders without direct authority to harmonize on strategy and sequencing.
* Analytical Decision Support: Utilize advanced data analysis to guide executive decision-making. Execute strategies that integrate stakeholder requirements across the end-to-end financial journey.
* AI & Automation Enablement: Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern finance technologies to streamline processes, improve insights, and accelerate finance transformation outcomes.
* Adoption & Change Leadership mindset: Spearhead the change management efforts by working with the change team for transformation initiatives, including developing and executing targeted communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and detailed training programs to ensure successful adoption and full integration of new processes and systems.

**Key Competencies**

* ERP fluency: Can configure, test, and troubleshoot core ERP Cloud modules without hand-holding from IT.
* Speed with discipline: Moves fast and delivers in small, visible increments, without skipping discovery or letting solutions get ahead of the evidence.
* Builder mindset: Comfortable building Claude/AI solutions, not just specifying them — writes prompts, builds agents and workflow automation, and turns an idea into something testable within days.
* Rigor and candor: Grounds every claim in observed data or documented sources, reports progress honestly, and knows the difference between built, piloted, and adopted.
* User empathy: Understands how analysts actually work and treats friction as a capability or tool gap, not a performance issue.
* Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind.
* Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind.
* Clear communication across time zones: Leads with the answer, adapts to executive, partner, and builder audiences, and works effectively with global stakeholders through strong asynchronous communication and reliable overlap hours.

****Qualifications****
**Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a strong process and transformation leader with experience
  
  
spanning finance processes, business systems, and cross-functional program delivery. They understand core finance and accounting deeply enough to engage credibly with finance stakeholders, while also bringing the structured thinking and technical fluency needed to guide solution design and systems-enabled change.
  
  
They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, and influencing across a complex
  
  
stakeholder environment. They can balance strategic roadmap thinking with practical execution, and they bring a modernization mindset that includes process simplification, connected processes, and thoughtful application of AI and emerging technologies.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in finance/accounting roles with deep domain expertise in financial systems, processes, and large-scale transformation projects.
* Subject matter expertise in the core financials, including Plan-to-Perform, Record-to-Report, Fixed Assets, Source-to-Pay, and direct & Indirect tax.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience building processes and leveraging automation or AI-enabled solutions, such as LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, and workflow automation.
* Experience with process discovery and mapping methods, such as process mining or task monitoring, value-stream mapping, and user interviews.
* Ability to connect the core financials end-to-end process design with the data model, AI/automation, and technology to cross-process dependencies (planning, forecasting, and budgeting)
* Proven track record of orchestrating large-scale, multi-year finance transformation programs, effectively managing dependencies between technical implementations (ERP & SaaS) and business process re-engineering efforts.
* Expert understanding of core accounting principles (e.g., US GAAP, IFRS) and their application in a systems environment.
* Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into a scalable system architecture.
* Excellent communication skills to work effectively with stakeholders across the organization. You must be able to influence cross-functional senior leaders to use data and insights to inform business strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale change initiatives, operate

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect - Distribution Technology
jobs.description:

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Solution Architect to provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership across Distribution Technology platforms and strategic initiatives. The role is responsible for translating business and technology requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable solutions spanning Microsoft Azure, data platforms, API and integration architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions.This is not a conceptual architecture position. Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues spanning multiple technology layers.

Define data structures, views and interfaces consumed by applications and analytics platforms.
  
  
Partner with enterprise data and application teams on entity, client and product data integrations.
  
  
Support data lineage, data quality and troubleshooting across complex flows.
  
  
**DevSecOps and Engineering Enablement**
Define and improve automated CI/CD patterns for cloud applications and services.
  
  
Work with enterprise DevOps teams to automate build, deployment and environment workflows.
  
  
Promote infrastructure automation, repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
  
  
Establish engineering practices that improve deployment reliability and reduce manual operational effort.
  
  
Provide architecture and technical guidance on source control, deployment pipelines, configuration and runtime environments.
  
  
**Strategic Platforms and Emerging Technology·**
Provide architecture leadership for strategic NTAM Distribution initiatives involving digital, data and AI capabilities.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise AI and platform teams on infrastructure and integration requirements for GenAI-enabled applications.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technology through prototypes and proof-of-concepts while keeping architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
Develop reusable architecture approaches for new capabilities rather than creating initiative-specific solutions wherever possible.

**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

Manager

8+ years in banking; 5+ years in business analysis or techno-functional consulting

jobs.title: FLEXCUBE Migration Consultant
jobs.description:
**FLEXCUBE Migration Consultant**

**Experience:** 5–15 Years  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

Levarus Solutions is looking for experienced FLEXCUBE Migration Consultants with strong hands-on experience in Core Banking data migration, system migration, and FLEXCUBE version migration projects.

We are seeking professionals who have practical experience in migrating legacy Core Banking Systems to FLEXCUBE and/or performing migration and upgrade activities across different FLEXCUBE versions, ranging from **11.8 to 14.x**.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in data migration, data mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and validation, along with good knowledge of FLEXCUBE modules and banking operations.

This is a dedicated migration role. Candidates with only production support, application maintenance, or general Oracle database migration experience without FLEXCUBE project exposure will not be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in end-to-end FLEXCUBE Core Banking migration projects.
* Execute data migration activities from legacy Core Banking Systems to Oracle FLEXCUBE.
* Work on FLEXCUBE version-to-version migration and upgrade projects across versions 11.8 to 14.x.
* Analyze source system data and perform source-to-target data mapping based on FLEXCUBE data structures.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation processes.
* Prepare and execute SQL/PL-SQL scripts for data migration, data conversion, and reconciliation.
* Perform data cleansing, transformation, validation, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Work on migration of core banking data, including Customer/CIF, CASA, Accounts, Loans, Deposits, General Ledger, and transaction records.
* Conduct mock migration runs, migration rehearsals, and data validation exercises.
* Identify migration gaps, data inconsistencies, and technical issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Prepare migration plans, mapping documents, technical specifications, validation reports, and reconciliation reports.
* Coordinate with functional consultants, technical developers, database teams, and banking stakeholders throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, production deployment, and go-live activities.
* Ensure successful migration execution within project timelines and quality standards.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in FLEXCUBE migration projects.
* Overall IT/Core Banking experience of 5–15 years.
* Mandatory FLEXCUBE project experience.
* Experience working with FLEXCUBE versions ranging from 11.8 to 14.x.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Hands-on experience in data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and data conversion.
* Expertise in source-to-target data mapping and migration strategy.
* Experience with Oracle database objects, packages, procedures, functions, and migration scripts.
* Knowledge of SQL\*Loader and data loading utilities.
* Experience in data reconciliation, data validation, and data integrity checks.
* Strong understanding of Core Banking modules such as:
* CASA (Current and Savings Accounts)
* Customer Information / CIF
* Branch Operations
* Teller Operations
* Loans and Lending
* Deposits and Term Deposits
* General Ledger (GL)
* Funds Transfer and Payments
* Understanding of migration testing, mock runs, cutover, and go-live activities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy banking platforms to FLEXCUBE.
* Experience in FLEXCUBE version migration and upgrades.
* Exposure to multiple Core Banking migration projects.
* Knowledge of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, or other ETL tools.
* Experience with Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting.
* Understanding of banking data models and FLEXCUBE database structures.
* Experience working with international banking clients and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

**Mandatory Eligibility Criteria**

* FLEXCUBE experience is mandatory.
* Candidates must have actual FLEXCUBE migration project experience.
* Experience in at least one complete or substantial migration project is preferred.
* Candidates must be able to explain the source banking system, target FLEXCUBE version, modules migrated, migration approach, and their individual contribution.
* Candidates with only general Oracle database migration or FLEXCUBE production support experience will not be considered.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for hands-on FLEXCUBE Migration Professionals who can independently manage migration deliverables, understand complex banking data structures, execute migration activities, and ensure accurate and seamless data transition.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical expertise, banking domain knowledge, ownership of migration activities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and client teams.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resumes.**

About Levarus Solutions

Levarus Solutions is an IT consulting and technology services company specializing in Core Banking, ERP, CRM, Business Intelligence, AI/ML, and Digital Transformation solutions. We help financial institutions modernize their technology platforms through enterprise-grade implementation and consulting services.

Pay: ₹473,000.00 - ₹2,830,000.00 per year

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

  
  

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Business Analytics****Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics.
* Help draft initial narrative summaries, executive dashboards, and documentation for final test result publication.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Track and update sprint milestones, deliverables, and cycle times to ensure on-time testing execution.
* Support team capacity planning by gathering allocation data and tracking utilization across testing stages.
* Assist in maintaining skill inventory matrices to facilitate optimal, competency-based resource assignment.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 5+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Technical Skills: Basic statistical Modeling (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree), SQL, SAS , Python

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

* undefined
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and completeness of financial and operational records across accounts, products and transaction platforms. The role provides critical control over the end-to-end reconciliation lifecycle by identifying, investigating and resolving breaks, exceptions and discrepancies in a timely manner, thereby reducing financial, operational and regulatory risk.

The role supports the effective operation of reconciliation processes covering Nostro accounts, General Ledger and suspense accounts, trade and position records, card and retail banking transactions, and other operational control accounts. Working across multiple business functions, the role ensures that reconciliation outcomes are achieved within agreed service levels while maintaining adherence to reconciliation policies, control standards and governance requirements.

The role also contributes to process optimisation and change initiatives by supporting system enhancements, reconciliation platform implementations, business analysis activities and automation opportunities that strengthen operational efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Reconciliation Control & Exception Management**  
• Perform reconciliations across cash, Nostro, General Ledger, suspense, trade, position and retail transaction accounts to ensure books and records are complete and accurate.
  
• Investigate, analyse and resolve reconciliation breaks, exceptions and unmatched items within agreed timelines to minimise operational and financial risk.
  
• Escalate aged, material or high-risk exceptions through appropriate governance channels to enable timely resolution and management oversight.
  
• Maintain accurate reconciliation evidence, audit trails and supporting documentation to support operational control and regulatory requirements.
  
**Financial Control & Risk Management**  
• Apply reconciliation policies, operational procedures and control frameworks to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements.
  
• Identify emerging risks, recurring exceptions and control weaknesses, recommending actions that improve reconciliation effectiveness and reduce operational losses.
  
• Monitor reconciliation ageing, exception volumes and service levels, ensuring timely reporting of key control indicators and risk exposures.
  
• Support business continuity, operational resilience and risk mitigation activities, including testing and execution of contingency plans.
  
**Stakeholder Engagement & Service Delivery**  
• Collaborate with Operations, Product, Finance, Technology and country teams to resolve reconciliation issues and improve control outcomes.
  
• Manage internal and external stakeholder enquiries relating to account balances, exceptions, investigations and reconciliation status.
  
• Coordinate resolution activities across multiple teams and functions to ensure dependencies are managed and service commitments are achieved.
  
• Build effective working relationships that support issue resolution, control transparency and operational effectiveness.

**• Support business analysis and requirement gathering for reconciliation platform enhancements and transformation initiatives.**  
**• Translate operational requirements into business rules, configuration requirements and process improvements for reconciliation solutions such as TLM.**  
**• Participate in testing activities, including UAT, validation and implementation readiness assessments, ensuring changes deliver expected business outcomes.**  
**• Support production deployments, operational readiness activities and post-implementation stabilisation to minimise disruption to reconciliation processes.**  
**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**  
**• Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate reconciliation activities to improve efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.**  
**• Analyse exception trends and operational data to recommend sustainable process enhancements and preventative controls.**  
**• Maintain process documentation, operating procedures, escalation matrices and control records to ensure operational consistency.**

Through effective leadership of people, operations and change initiatives, the role strengthens branch competitiveness, customer loyalty and long-term franchise growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Growth, Profitability & Market Development**  
• Achieve branch revenue and business targets by executing branch plans that drive customer acquisition, customer retention, relationship deepening and sustainable portfolio growth.
  
• Strengthen branch profitability by improving the deposit mix across current and savings accounts, increasing non-funded income, managing fee waivers effectively and maintaining expenditure within approved budgets.
  
• Increase customer value and product penetration by leading the branch’s growth across current accounts, savings accounts, term deposits, wealth management solutions, and secured and unsecured asset products.
  
• Improve customer retention and lifetime value by monitoring customer behaviours, identifying attrition risks and directing timely engagement that strengthens long-term banking relationships.
  
• Grow branch market share and competitiveness by championing product launches, sales initiatives, customer acquisition campaigns and local promotional activities relevant to the branch catchment area.
  
• Improve productivity and commercial outcomes by monitoring revenue, portfolio, customer, cost and sales performance indicators and taking timely corrective action.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Leadership**  
• Build customer trust, satisfaction and loyalty by establishing clear service expectations and embedding customer-focused behaviours across the branch.
  
• Improve the consistency and quality of customer service by reviewing customer feedback and service measures, observing frontline delivery, role-modelling expected standards and coaching colleagues on improvement priorities.
  
• Protect customer confidence and the Bank’s reputation by ensuring complex complaints, service failures and escalations are resolved promptly, fairly and within appropriate authority levels.
  
• Strengthen customer relationships by ensuring branch teams understand customer needs and provide access to relevant banking, wealth and financing capabilities across the Bank.
  
• Deliver fair and appropriate customer outcomes by reinforcing responsible selling, customer protection and service standards throughout branch activities.

**Branch Operations & Service Delivery**  
• Maintain reliable and efficient branch service delivery by overseeing daily operations, transaction authorisation, payment release, operational workflows and customer service capacity within delegated authorities.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Description**
Salesforce PS is seeking a Senior Director, Delivery Management to lead and scale the Global Migrations Hub (GMH) within the GDC. This is a senior executive role with full ownership of the GMH's strategy, delivery model, and people organization. The GMH is Salesforce's dedicated delivery factory for strategic platform migrations — accelerating customer transitions from legacy systems to modernized platforms driven by agentic tooling and an AI-native delivery framework.
  
  
Reporting to the GMH GDC Head, the Senior Director leads a multi-track organization of Architects, Project Managers, and Consultants across four practices. In addition to full delivery leadership, this role carries a team’s billable utilization target — engaging directly with customers as an advisor on the Hub's most complex migration engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Hub**

* Define and own the GMH's multi-year strategy — positioning the Hub as Salesforce's global center of excellence for platform migrations.
* Build and evolve the Migration Factory model: standardized delivery patterns, reusable accelerators, and wave-based execution playbooks across all tracks.
* Translate PS demand signals into Hub capability investments; align with Product Engineering on Revenue Cloud Advance, Marketing Cloud Next, Tableau Next, and Data Foundations migration roadmaps.
* Drive customer migrations by agentic AI tooling and toolkits to power customer success

**Delivery & Performance**

* Drive customer retention, growth, adoption, and value via modernized customer solutions.
* Own end-to-end delivery accountability across all active GMH programs — quality, timelines, optimized resourcing model, and customer satisfaction.
* Manage utilization, build a strong domain SME pool, and drive collaboration across Product & Engineering teams.
* Establish delivery governance, escalation protocols, and quality benchmarks across concurrent wave teams.

**People & Organisation**

* Lead, mentor, and develop up to 4 direct-report workstream leads, as well as an extended organization of Architects, PMs, and Consultants.
* Drive a high-performance, low-attrition culture with clear career paths, development frameworks, and performance standards.
* Own the Hub's hiring roadmap — partnering with Talent Acquisition to recruit top-tier migration specialists ahead of demand.

**Customer Engagement**

* Serve as an advisor on the Hub's highest-complexity migration engagements.
* Lead C-suite workshops on migration strategy, platform selection, and transformation roadmap design.
* Manage customer expectations, negotiate complex program challenges, and serve as the ultimate escalation point for the Hub's customer portfolio.

**Migration Factory IP & Go-to-Market**

* Own the Hub's IP portfolio: migration playbooks, assessment toolkits, data mapping templates, and factory accelerators.
* Champion Agentic tooling adoption — accelerating discovery, data profiling, transformation mapping, and testing through intelligent automation.
* Partner with PS Sales and Cloud Practices to scope migration opportunities; support pre-sales on large programs.

**Core Skills — Must Have**

* Migration methodology depth: data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping, reconciliation, cutover planning, and hypercare.
* Demonstrated track record scaling a GDC or delivery center organization — building practices and driving billability and margin at organizational level.
* Working migration/architectural knowledge across at least two of Revenue Cloud Advanced, MC Next, or Tableau Next — sufficient to lead technical reviews and advise customers.
* Executive presence: ability to represent Salesforce in C-suite conversations, board-level escalations, and PS leadership forums.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience in Salesforce or enterprise technology professional services, including individual contributor teams.
* 10+ years of people leadership, including direct management of Directors or Senior Managers.
* Demonstrated experience scaling a delivery center or CoE practice.
* Strong business acumen — utilization targets and HC planning for a large delivery function.
* Proficiency in English; strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel ~20–30% for customer engagements and leadership forums.
* Champion an organizational AI-first delivery methodology, driving the integration of advanced AI tools, project accelerators, and agentic evaluation frameworks to optimize execution velocity and elevate consulting quality across all practice programs.
* Drive a culture of continuous innovation, challenging the team to evolve delivery approaches and maximize the value of Salesforce products for clients.
* Lead through thought leadership, industry visibility, partner engagement, and a reputation for delivery excellence that makes clients want to work with us and talent want to join us.
* Champion GDC capabilities internally and externally; position the center as a strategic asset and a differentiator in contested sales situations.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on delivery experience on at least one large-scale Salesforce migration program.
* Experience building Agentic tooling or AI-assisted delivery automation in a PS context.
* Prior experience operating in a GDC / nearshore environment with specific understanding of billability economics and HC planning.
* Proven migration expertise — hands-on experience leading complex data and platform migrations (e.g., legacy CRM to Salesforce, org consolidations, multi-source data migration), with strong command of migration strategy, tooling, data quality, and cutover governance.
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling practice capability through pre-sales playbooks, architectural design frameworks, and demand planning.
* Proven ability to sell solutions at the C-level and consistently deliver revenue targets with accurate forecasting.
* Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles and different professional services engagement models.
* Experience building or contributing to brand positioning for a delivery organization — through content, partnerships, events, or industry recognition.
* Demonstrated understanding of integration frameworks and experience delivering performant, scalable, and robust complex Salesforce integrations.
* Strong grasp of business processes and their implementation into enterprise applications; ability to quickly translate technology concepts into business value.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

jobs.title: Head of Operations (Lounges)
jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.
  
  
We're looking for a Head of Operations to build and scale Revolut's global airport lounge network, from launching our first locations to managing a portfolio of lounges.
  
  
You'll own end-to-end lounge operations, ensuring each location delivers an exceptional customer experience while maximising commercial performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader with expertise in airport lounges and building scalable operations across markets.
  
  
Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading end-to-end operational readiness and launch of new airport lounges globally, coordinating with airport partners, operators, construction, design, and internal teams
* Owning day-to-day operational performance across the lounge network, ensuring consistently high standards of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency
* Maximising lounge profitability by driving revenue growth, optimising capacity utilisation, developing ancillary revenue opportunities, and managing operating costs
* Selecting, onboarding, and managing third-party lounge operators, establishing strict SLAs, performance targets, and governance mechanisms
* Defining and continuously improving premium hospitality standards across F&B, staffing, facilities, and customer experience
* Building scalable operating models, processes, reporting, and governance to support rapid expansion across multiple countries
* Ensuring compliance with relevant airport, safety, security, and local regulatory requirements
* Hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing operations team to support the growth of our global lounge network

**What You'll Need**

* Extensive experience in airport lounge operations, including successfully opening and operating lounges, ideally across multiple countries
* Experience managing multi-site airport lounge or premium hospitality operations, with direct accountability for operational performance and customer experience
* Commercial and financial acumen, paired with experience managing P&Ls, improving profitability, optimising capacity utilisation, and driving revenue growth
* An in-depth understanding of airport lounge operating models, including third-party operators, SLAs, airport requirements, hospitality standards, and F&B operations
* A track record of building operational processes, infrastructure, and teams from scratch and scaling them across multiple locations
* Solid stakeholder management skills, with experience working with airport authorities, operators, suppliers, and cross-functional teams
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to use data to drive operational improvements and ROI-based prioritisation
* An entrepreneurial mindset, capable of operating independently, and a willingness to be hands-on in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**

**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.
* Analysing our clients’ capabilities and finding opportunities to save costs and improve risk management through innovation within existing anti-financial crime and anti-fraud functions
* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.
* Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts).
* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry.

* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

**For senior level candidates**

* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.

* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.

* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

The Senior Manager - Migration Practice is a key member of Visa’s regional migration consulting capability. Proposition Development & Practice Support:
  
  

* Contribute to the evolution of Visa’s credit card migration consulting proposition in Asia Pacific (e.g., refining use cases, differentiators, client archetypes), under the guidance of the Migration Practice lead.
* Help maintain and enhance standard migration playbooks and toolkits, including:

+ Portfolio diagnostics and data-driven migration readiness assessments
+ Migration wave and cutover design templates
+ Customer impact, risk and contingency assessment tools

* Support the development of thought leadership and internal training materials (case studies, best practices, brown-bag sessions) to scale migration expertise across markets.

**Business Development & Deal Support**

* Work with the Migration Practice lead and Geo teams to identify and qualify migration opportunities, including platform changes, network shifts and large product/portfolio migrations.

* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses and commercial constructs, including scope definition, phasing, staffing recommendations and indicative timelines.

**Solution Design & Delivery**

* Lead defined workstreams within larger migration programs or own end-to-end delivery for smaller engagements, for example:

+ Segmentation and migration cohort strategy
+ Customer communication and experience design (pre-, during, post-migration)
+ Product mapping and benefit rationalization
+ Operational readiness and servicing impact assessment

* Translate network and issuer platform constraints into pragmatic migration strategies, in partnership with VCA Migration Tech, Product and client IT/Operations teams.
* Act as a first-line escalation and problem-solving point for issues within your workstreams, bringing in the Migration Practice lead or other experts as needed.

**Project Resourcing & Third-Party Coordination**

* Support in designing resourcing models that combine Visa consultants with third-party resources (consultancies, contractors) for large migrations.
* Coordinate day-to-day activities with third-party partners on your workstreams (clarifying roles, deliverables and quality standards).
* Contribute to SOW preparation, onboarding and performance tracking for external partners, ensuring their outputs are aligned with Visa’s methodology and client expectations.

**Governance, Risk Management & Measurement**

* Demonstrated experience leading or playing a core role in card or payment platform migrations, portfolio conversions, or similar large change programs.

Job Title
  
  
Senior Presales Manager / Lead Presales Consultant
